**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

And I’m afraid that they’ve been able to increase their influence in part because too many of us have lost sight of those same state races that shape our day-to-day lives and liberties. But not my friends at the DLCC – they’re the sole organization dedicated to electing Democrats to state legislatures across the country – and they're working day in and day out to reverse MAGA Republicans' grip on our statehouses. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. | | | __**[You may not know me, so let me share my story.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518737:JMeFK_VNK:m:1:3331421248:DC7C8D1A63668C749CFA5F7067A254E3:r "You may not know me, so let me share my story.")**__
My name's Tiffany Smiley. I'm a mom of three, veteran's wife, and Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I'm running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent to bring **real change** to our country.

I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq.

From there, I took on the federal government to fight for the rights that Scotty _**earned**_ as an active duty service member, and I _**won**_.

Fighting for Scotty inspired me to **advocate for _all_ veterans**, so I went to D.C. to speak up for those who put their lives on the line for our country.

Now, I need _your_ help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.

---
| | [HELP TIFFANY'S CAMPAIGN](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518737:JMeFK_VNK:m:1:3331421248:DC7C8D1A63668C749CFA5F7067A254E3:r "HELP TIFFANY’S CAMPAIGN")
---

Murray has been in office for _**three decades**_ and has done **nothing** to stop the rising crime, homelessness, and drug addiction crisis tearing my beloved home state apart.

I'm running for U.S. Senate because Americans deserve better than the failed leadership they've been stuck with for _years_.

It's time for a _**change**_ in D.C., and I'm the right person for the job.

The latest polls in Washington show that my opponent and I will be _**neck and neck**_ , and I'm getting nervous. We're _finally_ closing in on Murray, but I need your support to cross the finish line.

_**[Can you chip in any amount to help me take the lead to save Washington?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518737:JMeFK_VNK:m:1:3331421248:DC7C8D1A63668C749CFA5F7067A254E3:r "Can you chip in any amount to help me
take the lead to save Washington? ")**_

Your support will bring me closer to restoring the American dream from the U.S. Senate.

---

---

To victory,

Tiffany Smiley

Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518738:JMeFK_VNK:m:1:3331421248:DC7C8D1A63668C749CFA5F7067A254E3:r "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518740:JMeFK_VNK:m:1:3331421248:DC7C8D1A63668C749CFA5F7067A254E3:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for
your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518740:JMeFK_VNK:m:1:3331421248:DC7C8D1A63668C749CFA5F7067A254E3:r "Step up now!")**_

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
I wanted to share these special moments with you. [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c920805%7c6044%7c7%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c0&wdmdk=B4C9drBcQGqKsivYSX%2foyw&sysid=1)
I wanted to share these special moments with you.

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87546%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=x96lHm2uO%2fLXXX2Ach2i7Q&sysid=1 "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87547%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=CZncVQQi4ank2JBxvyDUtQ&sysid=1 "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87548%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=j5fl0SgdSaTwBXcsRAVg0A&sysid=1 "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty’s side.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87549%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=CS29TDFhCqOIfgLDNaH5aQ&sysid=1 "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty’s immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87540%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=PRTVeVvv436ScwwidPHG2Q&sysid=1 "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran
gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87541%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=3CkORIoKtpTX0H1XAVhrew&sysid=1 "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer,
breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It’s not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87542%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=SOXIotDEe3cXVrjEIdlVlQ&sysid=1 "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for
our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to ‘see’ our children’s faces, he’s always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87543%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ZeU4kvNqsVsNk%2bIZYTW7ww&sysid=1 "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I’ve shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87544%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=uSaNtv6%2bmRwL0v5mBkBgjA&sysid=1 "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and
end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can’t do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far.](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87655%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=S2qemJrNK7WPZ2nSZidUew&sysid=1 "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks
to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87656%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=h5h%2bvwyKL8XJi%2fvXB2GvaQ&sysid=1 "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87657%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=M3fCuCBl0MFl4vX%2bgvf54A&sysid=1 "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87658%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6CBicV%2fVkSAjzTDyK1aMpA&sysid=1 "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it’s Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can’t make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87659%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xaUB5S1aL370Y5CWSShuoA&sysid=1 "Rush support now to be a part of
history")**_.

Let’s raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87650%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=bE7%2b5BQJSM1q7gbk1Azuog&sysid=1 "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---
| [](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87651%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KVrQuBzK%2bBddWg9alPuRXQ&sysid=1 "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87652%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Ctl9tmVd%2fw87a8%2bbS%2f61hQ&sysid=1 "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help
in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c87653%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=IikDPMuK1aV2dvnoy6RZ0g&sysid=1 "Step up now!")**_

---

body:
I wanted to share these special moments with you.

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zvd9s4u8i73qga166hvj5vl3pfmq8fdp5ifg8bcg_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1im2o36c1h2bs "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zp9necjdpcl1fsrdi35jp88m8cclpbusiuur2d4g_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1im2o36c1h2bs "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z4gk2gk1e1uueaqffa1ah1fudg4aaamtv0ki98so_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1im2o36c1h2bs "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zgqq8bkbgbualcou8h37jrf0f2oo5rnm7e99tu6g_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1im2o36c1h2bs "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zbbad9bg8q5hfqnh326d7v0dhv20harafv8f9q6o_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1im2o36c1h2bs "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zvqkoc5mbhsnq2s95lr0horfpr4052jqggvp4r9o_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1im2o36c1h2bs "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z97uqr9rr71jmglvc9on57jdcp6046or2gr7502g_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1im2o36c1h2bs "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z7d2tigvq7iej33jjv5rhshu9003enroltjvrtrg_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1im2o36c1h2bs "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z5ucsqeaj4hfu3nmhg5sdetrb0pv2hii6sgeql3o_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1im2o36c1h2bs "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zf4efitbith9k6cutpqnhbute7ahjdjnso182lro_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1im2o36c1h2bs "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far.")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z6bd6hh8r9vd5j8dh8qcs7eit0uulk1t3pmu6vq8_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1im2o36c1h2bs "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zsg8u7e15eiqah7bk249ttc9rnpsgauas5hb7bm0_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1im2o36c1h2bs "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zuh4nu66fsjngj2k25e52agv2kckk1ug5lin3u9g_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1im2o36c1h2bs "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z6l8ev3p7mgbierjp2kmoj6600fjhq61vl79nok8_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1im2o36c1h2bs "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zi63a6694ksto18suslkmofuhlqcq8m2q5rocu0o_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1im2o36c1h2bs "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zqu2ln0a3njnjaf9lm207o4uro152n3s6lqmm9rg_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1im2o36c1h2bs "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z7vh4pp7nmgslkv076ht63lehn2q58ctvetehjlg_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1im2o36c1h2bs "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zjssfuoauq5l45pnvv79rfcgqhfnobnbb46uvcn0_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1im2o36c1h2bs "Step up now!")**_

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: Fighting back against the transgender agenda
body:
| | | Peter, Imagine that you've just been called into the middle school principal's office to have a "serious talk" about your daughter. You're worried -- is it her grades? Her behavior? Is she hurt? Instead, the principal tells you that your daughter -- your 12- year-old little girl -- is now your son. That behind your back, the school has been "educating" your preteen daughter \-- for months, in total secret -- about how to "transition" her gender. And they instructed her to keep it hidden from you...because you "can't be trusted." That you, her parent, are not "safe." But now, she has a new name. New pronouns. A new bathroom. And you just need to accept it. _Wouldn 't you be furious?_ I know I would be! So it's no surprise that's exactly how Jessica Konen felt when she was called into her daughter's California middle school and this nightmare played out in real life. **Now, Jessica is fighting back and suing the school district -- plus the principal and the two teachers who "groomed" her daughter -- and she needs your help to win justice in a court of law. ** [**Will you please make an urgent, tax-deductible donation to the Center for American Liberty and help us fund this lawsuit while generating a nationwide wave of support for Jessica and her daughter?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61521276:6LH27_VeN:m:1:3331421248:D4AA32114EBF4828CC11BDEEE4BB2B92:r) I hope you will, because as infuriating as that story is, the details are even more outrageous. Would you believe Jessica's daughter was just eleven when she was lured by these teachers to join their so-called "Equality Club"? **_They first convinced this little girl that she was bisexual. Then, as they sunk their hooks deeper, they told her -- not long after her twelfth birthday -- that really, she was probably "transgender." _** "But don't tell your parents!" they warned. In fact, they operated the entire club under a cloak of secrecy. No permission slips were signed. No attendance was taken. No membership lists were kept. Meetings were scheduled for lunchtime -- instead of after school, like other clubs -- so parents wouldn't begin to wonder where their kids were. What were they hiding?? If you've followed the growing nationwide problem of teachers "grooming" young, confused students -- you probably know some of the predatory tactics these teachers often use to manipulate vulnerable children into believing they're "transgender" or "non-binary." This case was no exception. In fact, these two teachers even let some of their secrets slip on leaked audio from a Teachers Association conference! Discussing how they managed to target so many new recruits for their club, one of the teachers confessed: "We totally stalked what they were doing on Google." **These teachers zeroed in on confused and troubled students and -- instead of helping them -- they further filled these children 's heads with lies and more confusion. ** [**Which is why I 'm asking you to make an urgent donation of $35 or more today if you agree with our lawsuit against these teachers, the principal, and the Spreckels Union School District.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61521276:6LH27_VeN:m:1:3331421248:D4AA32114EBF4828CC11BDEEE4BB2B92:r) My name is Harmeet Dhillon. I'm a lawyer, and the founder of the Center for American Liberty. You may recognize me from one of my many Fox News appearances with Jessica Konen or other plaintiffs my nonprofit organization is representing in lawsuits against government officials who violate Americans' rights. Today, I'm asking you to join us in support of Jessica's case. It's clear that the defendants deprived Jessica Konen of her civil rights as a parent, that they conspired to do so, and that they inflicted emotional distress on both Jessica and her daughter. Those legal claims and more are at the heart of our lawsuit. I believe our evidence lays out a very strong case. But you must remember, this is a California school district and the defense's case will be funded by the government. And it will pay whatever it takes to defend leftist ideologies. [**That 's why, I hope you'll also consider making a generous donation of $25, $35, $50 or $100 to help fund our case. **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61521276:6LH27_VeN:m:1:3331421248:D4AA32114EBF4828CC11BDEEE4BB2B92:r) The Center for American Liberty is a nonprofit organization, meaning we receive no government funding -- _unlike the deep-pocketed defendants in most of our cases._ Because of this, we rely on support from generous Americans who can recognize an injustice and want to see it set right. Our nonprofit status also means your donation is tax-deductible to the fullest extent allowed by law. We've seen evidence of this type of "grooming" at schools across the country. And it's not just in places like California! Dangerous teachers like this are unfortunately in classrooms across the country. Thankfully, the tide seems to be turning against them. Earlier this year, Governor DeSantis outlawed teachers from having these sexualized conversations with their young students. And elsewhere, parents have gotten involved with their local school boards to run for office and change policies that have put radical gender ideology ahead of student safety or parental rights. Those are political solutions. **Ours is a legal one.** And I believe that, in order to fully purge this predatory behavior from our schools, we need to fight this battle on all available fronts. Won't you please help us win this fight in a court of law?**[Join the fight with a generous donation of $35 or more so the courts, the plaintiffs, the defendants -- everybody -- will know how big the nationwide movement to protect kids has grown. ](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61521276:6LH27_VeN:m:1:3331421248:D4AA32114EBF4828CC11BDEEE4BB2B92:r)** ** ** No parent should have to endure what Jessica Konen and her daughter did, and it's up to us to use the full force of the law to make sure no teacher is allowed to get away with this again. Thank you,
---
| |
---
|
---
| | P.S. Winning this case will not only get justice for the Konen family, but also strike a blow against these dangerous school policies nationwide. **[Which is why I hope we can count on your generous tax-deductible donation of $25, $35, $50 or more to help us win this lawsuit and others like it. Thank you!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61521276:6LH27_VeN:m:1:3331421248:D4AA32114EBF4828CC11BDEEE4BB2B92:r) **

If I don't turn things around on the fundraising side, I'm going to be absolutely humiliated. There's no easy way for me to say this so I'll get right to it. I've put my heart and soul into this campaign for almost two years straight. On November 8th I want each and everyone of us to be able to say, "I have nothing left to give. I gave it my all." So, I'm humbly asking if you'll help me out with a few extra bucks today to keep me from being humiliated and embarrassed by Nancy Pelosi?

## Dear Patriots 4 Peroutka Supporters,

## Maryland needs an Attorney General who shows integrity and doesn't compromise!

### Recently Michael Peroutka was approached by the Washington Post regarding an endorsement. See Peroutka's principled response below:
---
Mr. Lee Hockstader Editorial Board Washington Post Dear Mr. Hockstader: Thank you for your recent communication with my campaign for Attorney General of Maryland in which you indicated a desire to speak with me regarding your upcoming endorsement of candidates in statewide races. Please know that while I am grateful for your interest in my views and vision for carrying out the constitutional duties of this important office, I want to make clear that I do not seek the endorsement of the Washington Post. Intending no disrespect nor offense, I am not convinced that your endorsement, should you decide to provide it, would be helpful to my campaign. Regrettably, the reputation of The Washington Post for objectivity and journalistic integrity is not generally an honorable one. Among many, The Washington Post is seen as overtly biased and therefore unreliable as a source of news or opinion. Significant details about my positions on critical issues are available at patriots4peroutka.com. My very best wishes, _Michael Anthony Peroutka_ _Republican candidate for Attorney General of Maryland_

Recently Michael Peroutka was approached by the Washington Post regarding an endorsement. See Peroutka's principled response below: Mr. Lee Hockstader Editorial Board Washington Post Dear Mr. Hockstader: Thank you for your recent communication with my campaign for Attorney General of Maryland in which you indicated a desire to speak with me regarding your upcoming endorsement of candidates in statewide races. Please know that while I am grateful for your interest in my views and vision for carrying out the constitutional duties of this important office, I want to make clear that I do not seek the endorsement of the Washington Post. Intending no disrespect nor offense, I am not convinced that your endorsement, should you decide to provide it, would be helpful to my campaign. Regrettably, the reputation of The Washington Post for objectivity and journalistic integrity is not generally an honorable one. Among many, The Washington Post is seen as overtly biased and therefore unreliable as a source of news or opinion. Significant details about my positions on critical issues are available at patriots4peroutka.com. Peter,

**The Left is so desperate to hold their majority in the Senate, they're willing to do anything to win this seat in Georgia - including lie.**

Now, a liberal publication is claiming that I paid for a woman to have an abortion. **This is a flat-out lie - and I deny this in the strongest possible terms.**

This is another repugnant hatchet job from a Democrat activist, disguised as a reporter, who has obsessively attacked my family and tried to tear me down since this race started. He's harassed friends of mine, asking if I fathered their children. He's called my children 'secret' because I didn't want to use them as campaign props in a political campaign. They think they can threaten me. They think they can scare me. Right now, all they've done is energize me more.

_**[I'm going to fight and win this seat for the great people of Georgia, but I need you to stand with me.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61526267:JJANM_VNr:m:1:3317145305:6719BB9AE212B1C14A1CB9AB70CBC27E:r)**_

The Left needs this Georgia seat to maintain their power, but we're not going to let them have it. If they take this seat, we won't recognize this country tomorrow.

What they're doing to me - and other candidates - is not right.

**[They are desperate to win these Senate seats because they want to change this country, but we're not going to let it happen.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61526267:JJANM_VNr:m:1:3317145305:6719BB9AE212B1C14A1CB9AB70CBC27E:r)**

name: Rev. Warnock
subject: I'm fighting hard to keep Dr. King's dream of justice and equality alive in Washington.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warnock for Georgia
body:
| | |
---
Friend: From a young age, my parents taught me what it meant to be of service to others. My dad was a veteran, small businessman, and preacher. My mom worked hard to raise my siblings and me and instill in us the belief that we could do anything we put our minds to.

Today, I'm proud to serve the people of Georgia in the Senate – but my work doesn't stop there. I serve as the senior pastor at Ebenezer Baptist Church, the spiritual home of Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. **Sometimes folks ask me, "What is it like to walk in Dr. King's shoes?"** I always tell them I've never tried.** ****We don't need to walk in his shoes; we need to stand on his shoulders and meet today's moment. **

Understanding that my service doesn't stop at the church doors is a big part of why I ran for Senate in the first place. Now, I'm fighting hard to keep Dr. King's dream of justice and equality alive in Washington.
**But I'll be honest:_NPR_ is calling me one of the most vulnerable Democratic senators up for reelection – and new polls show this race neck and neck. The only way I can defend my seat and win our critical fights for justice is with your help. [I'm personally asking: Will you give $5 or more right now to help me keep Georgia blue, defend our Senate majority, and build a better future for our country?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52055483/371112183/-598064402?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4392-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZmIwMTRiOS02NjQ1LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=98bg6qTH8jqscfIsfGWpKnv76yRjDOoLSA74agtDVD0=)**

name: Candace Owens
subject: Hollywood = Satanic Values
body:
[](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8c190a8a4f3e41acbb7401a34bb425c7&_e=T-9gNQneanqFldTIdMzBATmF7WMBW5d76lPi5rvPfqhuDkDkZsPPPBurygdue97SnQisgJkoJNSqSLWWlRlVIcc6dyGevamd_3AYVu3ICbieIrj0g1o3owBmV1WmJuMnpuYYEWHLQWeDnW2-RcBzXKoKCYLm4zKbWsl0m4-eE-6hNE0xRh5GA4BlQfmIhJ91lK_wudSTAthbOCHn6P4x4C2FcY1FylxE_V3N7AQydqsd6tlPyYrShjfltNlDHCIAykZU3pNjezGq0jGl-hTagZ7P-9RwTEduKmIdRw-oGiA%3D)
Friend,

Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to **sell?**

Because that’s exactly what happened — Kris Jenner watched AND hand-picked which sex tape her daughter Kim Kardashian would release!

**It is not an exaggeration to say that Hollywood is satanic.**
What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex?

If that disgusts you, here’s where it gets worse. _It worked_. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire, and she’s still selling sex.

She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you’re willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more.

**Is this the example we want to leave for our children?**

At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence.

My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance.

I’ve set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don’t have to be like the Kardashians to be successful.

[**Can you support this critical mission with a gift of $10, $25, or even $50? Click here to donate today >>>**](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8c190a8a4f3e41acbb7401a34bb425c7&_e=T-9gNQneanqFldTIdMzBATmF7WMBW5d76lPi5rvPfqhuDkDkZsPPPBurygdue97SnQisgJkoJNSqSLWWlRlVIcc6dyGevamd_3AYVu3ICbieIrj0g1o3owBmV1WmJuMnpuYYEWHLQWeDnW2-RcBzXJ7I-_90hKx7gmVkh8iS6TGRYHH0SHjSe96rbGralvDRy9IZHrR0w1DaMAcR-HUmiwmilztI8c7mK-18hFzCZj24E3pMj7KXdR-1byK99Aa_plo8bVl-N_6iN1EX8-cJhVD5Z6lVwInjkP67lqOfYYg%3D)

BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters.

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies.

Just this summer, **BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people.** They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration.

**BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children** for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp.

The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland!

Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program – Liberation Camp – for 80 children.

_BLEXIT’s Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative_.

The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter **distributed over 400 school supplies** and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago’s most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to **give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags.**

BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America’s minority communities.

[**We currently have 42 chapters across the US and more than 14,000 volunteers! You can help BLEXIT support our State Chapters by donating $10, $25, $50, or any other amount today. Click here to send your gift >>>**](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8c190a8a4f3e41acbb7401a34bb425c7&_e=T-9gNQneanqFldTIdMzBATmF7WMBW5d76lPi5rvPfqhuDkDkZsPPPBurygdue97SnQisgJkoJNSqSLWWlRlVIcc6dyGevamd_3AYVu3ICbieIrj0g1o3owBmV1WmJuMnpuYYEWHLQWeDnW2-RcBzXFmS4CdviRCWE2YGQnQ-hQnhRzn0dugnmO0ecRIv58HukOIZR3h-te6j9KB_-Zp6wnqyZ39430NsQyWbKn-eX-a-WajeWp65UK5Li8MeptmbqbauxPki-AZlxsVGJbslpMd6lT3x22GZvbQEHDaY8Dw%3D)

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities.

These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them.

But here’s the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community:

* They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities.

* They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers.

* They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves.

**These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.**

BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can’t do it alone, Friend. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000?

name: Chair Jaime Harrison
subject: Happy National Hispanic Heritage Month, Derek.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Democratic National Committee, **[www
body:
I always enjoy this month because it reminds us that there is no singular identity that defines the American experience. | |
---
Derek -- Happy National Hispanic Heritage Month! I always enjoy this month because it reminds us that there is no singular identity that defines the American experience. We all start at different points and walk different paths, but we’re all walking toward the same dream. Similarly, there is no singular identity that defines the Latino community. However, we’re all linked by the same hope for a better future -- not just for ourselves, but for our families and neighbors as well. That brings me to the other reason that this month excites me so much: it focuses on the future. Hispanic and Latino voters have driven turnout in three of the fastest growing states in the country: Arizona, Nevada, and Texas. Over 60 percent of Latinos are under the age of 35. The future of this country is closely tied to the Latino community. Latino voters are a powerful force in our democracy, and Democrats have an incredible story to tell about the results we’ve been able to deliver for the Latino community because of their support. Democrats will continue our intensive work to earn the votes of Latino and Hispanic communities this month and every month beyond. Through the launch of the DNC’s Latino Signature Program, _Adelante_ , we have consistently invested in reaching out to Latinos in Spanish across the country through phone calls, text messages, and community events that meet voters exactly where they are. We are not taking anything for granted, and we will continue to highlight how the leadership of President Biden and Democrats is delivering for Latino families. That’s why the DNC has dedicated over half a million dollars in paid media to Hispanic outreach this month alone. We will be running ads on Spanish-language radio stations and Spanish-language newspapers as well as digital ads in both English and Spanish. All of this is in addition to the more than seven figures we have invested in Spanish-language radio and print in a dozen states. We have also partnered with sister committees and state parties to invest in Latino coalition-building and organizing in targeted coordinated campaigns across the country. Additionally, we hosted a Campaign Readiness Project bootcamp focused around recruiting, training, and placing diverse, local staff in battleground states. This effort helped increase bilingual staff on the ground and put particular focus on recruiting for bilingual communications, coalitions, and organizing staff to help build the pipeline for both 2022 and 2024. In short, Democrats are working hard for you. We’re working to serve everyone in this country -- not just the people who voted for us. We are doing everything we can to unite while Republicans continue to actively divide. When they’re not playing callous political games with the lives of immigrants, they’re pushing for policies no one wants like a national abortion ban. They’re threatening to take away our Social Security and Medicare. They’re trying to make it harder for us to vote. They’re even threatening the survival of the planet. All of this so that they can divide us and hold onto power. They have no interest in serving even the people who elected them. Republicans in office just serve their own personal interests. So as you celebrate National Hispanic Heritage Month and think about the future of this country, it’s time to think about Election Day. We’ve been doing the legwork since January 2021. The special elections and primaries were all dress rehearsals, and the main event is next. We know who our candidates are. We know what they need. They need you. As always, you have my deepest gratitude for all that you have done for us so far. November is right around the corner. Jaime Jaime Harrison
Chair
Democratic National Committee

**_Folks You Should Know_**
**Gabriela Cristobal, Women's Coalition Director**
Gabriela was previously the Director of Programs & Strategic Engagement at United State of Women, a nonprofit born out of the Obama administration's White House Council on Women and Girls. During her time at USOW, she led their training and volunteer programs and partnerships and developed issue advocacy campaigns on topics like the criminalization of Black girls and student loan debt. She has also served on the UN Foundation's Global Health Advocacy Team, where she trained and mobilized grassroots organizers across the country, including at the United Nations. Gabriela mentors through the Mercile J. Lee Scholarship Program and as a member of Girls Inc. Next Generation Leadership Committee. **Kraynal Alfred, Native Coalitions Director**
Kraynal, a Navajo Nation Citizen, is Tódich'ii'nii (Bitter Water) clan born for Tó’áhání (Near the Water) clan. In pursuing her passion for tribal outreach and political engagement, Kraynal was a student in the Native American Political Leadership Program (NAPLP) at The George Washington University where she returned to develop the INSPIRE Pre-College Program for Native high school students. During the most recent two DNC Conventions, Kraynal served as a volunteer on the DNC Media Logistics Team. Over the course of her career, Kraynal also has worked for the Navajo Nation, the National Congress of American Indians, the National Indian Health Board, the Office of Public Affairs for Indian Affairs, and, most recently, as the Tribal Liaison for the Universal Service Administrative Company.

clean_body: I always enjoy this month because it reminds us that there is no singular identity that defines the American experience. | | Derek -- Happy National Hispanic Heritage Month! I always enjoy this month because it reminds us that there is no singular identity that defines the American experience. We all start at different points and walk different paths, but we’re all walking toward the same dream. Similarly, there is no singular identity that defines the Latino community. However, we’re all linked by the same hope for a better future -- not just for ourselves, but for our families and neighbors as well. That brings me to the other reason that this month excites me so much: it focuses on the future. Hispanic and Latino voters have driven turnout in three of the fastest growing states in the country: Arizona, Nevada, and Texas. Over 60 percent of Latinos are under the age of 35. The future of this country is closely tied to the Latino community. Latino voters are a powerful force in our democracy, and Democrats have an incredible story to tell about the results we’ve been able to deliver for the Latino community because of their support. Democrats will continue our intensive work to earn the votes of Latino and Hispanic communities this month and every month beyond. Through the launch of the DNC’s Latino Signature Program, Adelante , we have consistently invested in reaching out to Latinos in Spanish across the country through phone calls, text messages, and community events that meet voters exactly where they are. We are not taking anything for granted, and we will continue to highlight how the leadership of President Biden and Democrats is delivering for Latino families. That’s why the DNC has dedicated over half a million dollars in paid media to Hispanic outreach this month alone. We will be running ads on Spanish-language radio stations and Spanish-language newspapers as well as digital ads in both English and Spanish. All of this is in addition to the more than seven figures we have invested in Spanish-language radio and print in a dozen states. We have also partnered with sister committees and state parties to invest in Latino coalition-building and organizing in targeted coordinated campaigns across the country. Additionally, we hosted a Campaign Readiness Project bootcamp focused around recruiting, training, and placing diverse, local staff in battleground states. This effort helped increase bilingual staff on the ground and put particular focus on recruiting for bilingual communications, coalitions, and organizing staff to help build the pipeline for both 2022 and 2024. In short, Democrats are working hard for you. We’re working to serve everyone in this country -- not just the people who voted for us. We are doing everything we can to unite while Republicans continue to actively divide. When they’re not playing callous political games with the lives of immigrants, they’re pushing for policies no one wants like a national abortion ban. They’re threatening to take away our Social Security and Medicare. They’re trying to make it harder for us to vote. They’re even threatening the survival of the planet. All of this so that they can divide us and hold onto power. They have no interest in serving even the people who elected them. Republicans in office just serve their own personal interests. So as you celebrate National Hispanic Heritage Month and think about the future of this country, it’s time to think about Election Day. We’ve been doing the legwork since January 2021. The special elections and primaries were all dress rehearsals, and the main event is next. We know who our candidates are. We know what they need. They need you. As always, you have my deepest gratitude for all that you have done for us so far. November is right around the corner. Jaime Jaime Harrison Chair Democratic National Committee On the Ground For the first time since 1964, the state of Washington The efforts of the Washington State Democratic Party blocked Republicans from advancing a candidate through the top two format primary. Democrat incumbent Steve Hobbs was appointed to the position last November, and he’s running to complete the term against an independent. A successful campaign for state treasurer would make , former Vice Chair of the Connecticut Democratic Party, the country’s first openly gay Black person elected to statewide office. An attorney specializing in public financing, Erick pledged to invest Connecticut’s nearly $45 billion in pension assets to expand economic opportunities for working families. is vying to be the first woman to represent Vermont in the U.S. Congress. Her victory would mean that every U.S. state has finally sent a woman to Congress. She has already made history as the first woman and president pro tempore of the Vermont Senate. The ASDC had a successful third quarter membership meeting on September 7. About 70% of the ASDC membership was in attendance, and programming included speakers from Everytown for Gun Safety, League of Conservation Voters, NARAL, Lake Research Partners, and several departments at the DNC. Folks You Should Know Gabriela Cristobal, Women's Coalition Director Gabriela was previously the Director of Programs & Strategic Engagement at United State of Women, a nonprofit born out of the Obama administration's White House Council on Women and Girls. During her time at USOW, she led their training and volunteer programs and partnerships and developed issue advocacy campaigns on topics like the criminalization of Black girls and student loan debt. She has also served on the UN Foundation's Global Health Advocacy Team, where she trained and mobilized grassroots organizers across the country, including at the United Nations. Gabriela mentors through the Mercile J. Lee Scholarship Program and as a member of Girls Inc. Next Generation Leadership Committee. Kraynal Alfred, Native Coalitions Director Kraynal, a Navajo Nation Citizen, is Tódich'ii'nii (Bitter Water) clan born for Tó’áhání (Near the Water) clan. In pursuing her passion for tribal outreach and political engagement, Kraynal was a student in the Native American Political Leadership Program (NAPLP) at The George Washington University where she returned to develop the INSPIRE Pre-College Program for Native high school students. During the most recent two DNC Conventions, Kraynal served as a volunteer on the DNC Media Logistics Team. Over the course of her career, Kraynal also has worked for the Navajo Nation, the National Congress of American Indians, the National Indian Health Board, the Office of Public Affairs for Indian Affairs, and, most recently, as the Tribal Liaison for the Universal Service Administrative Company. body:
This is one of the last opportunities I have to make my case directly to Arizona before early voting begins. | | |
---
Team,
Back in the Navy, you did a lot of work before a big mission.
You knew your job front and back. You trusted your leaders. You could count on your team.
Tonight, I've got a debate. I'm ready to do my part. But before I take the stage, I need to know you have my back.
Here's why: **This is one of the last opportunities I have to make my case directly to Arizona before early voting begins.**
**[So, before I take the stage, I'm hoping you'll chip in $5.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52076521/371193896/1960279368?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3719-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMjNmYmJlZS04ZjQ1LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ayMrSKjbL50ZsAQBcCVE6eNoQkSl0oa86BUTPuUOfG4=)**
Team, we've missed our goals a few months in a row now — and that's started hitting our plans to reach voters across Arizona. body:
Politicians are supposed to serve constituents, bring people together for the common good, and keep our democracy strong.
| | |
---
Peter, on Jan. 6, 2021, I watched in horror, like countless other Americans did, as our Capitol was attacked in a deadly insurrection fueled by lies, conspiracy theories, and hate. In that moment, I knew that I needed to do something.
Since then, I have seen the division in our politics and our communities grow even more extreme. I have seen the work of legislating devolve into mud-slinging and partisan attacks. **I have seen politics and vitriol tear families, friends, and neighbors apart.**
This is _not_ how politics are supposed to work.
Politicians are supposed to serve constituents, bring people together for the common good, and keep our democracy strong. You simply cannot do that while you're defending, excusing, ignoring, or even inciting an insurrection.
I am running for the Senate for so many reasons – ending the opioid epidemic, giving families the real solutions that they need to make ends meet, restoring our right to bodily autonomy, and more. **But the deadly extremism and division in our politics is what first convinced me that I needed to take action _._**

Friends, I just wanted to send a note of gratitude. Last week I shared that if we reached our End-of-Quarter goal, then my staff would let me leave call time early this week to knock on doors. Cash is essential to keeping our campaign strong, but between dialing-for-dollars and talking to voters, I’m always going to prefer the latter. **Thanks to your support, we hit our goal, and I got to hit the pavement!** At every doorstep I’m learning a new story, but I’ve noticed the same fears come up time and again. From my conversations, it’s clear our district is aching for a representative that will focus on climate action, voting rights, and abortion access. Our neighbors are scared for the safety of their homes, families, and environment as the wildfires rage and climate change only worsens. They’re pissed about the far-right push to restrict access to the ballot box and overturn free and fair elections. And there is serious concern around my opponent’s anti-choice record, and the GOP’s plan to pass a nationwide abortion ban if they take the majority in November. I want you to know that I am listening, and I **__will__** take action. I swore an oath to serve our country when I joined the Navy, and I took the hippocratic oath when I became a doctor. If I win in November I will take the oath of office to uphold the Constitution, **but today I want to swear an oath to you, the voters, that if we win, I will take with me to Congress your stories, your fears, and your hope-filled dreams.** The time for change is now. It can’t wait. Sincerely, Dr. Kermit Jones

clean_body: | Peter — Abortion rights are an economic justice issue. As Speaker, Tina worked to ensure Oregon has some of the strongest abortion protections in the nation. These safeguards boost our economy by ensuring Oregonians have the freedom to plan whether and when they start their family. But for the millions of women who don’t have access to abortion across the country, the economic consequences for being forced to carry a pregnancy can be dire. And that’s especially true for people who already face the greatest barriers to economic advancement. With the costs of childcare getting more expensive, and inflation continuing to rise, Tina understands the economic threat that abortion bans force on our communities. Tina’s opponents can’t say the same. In fact, her Republican opponent was endorsed by a group that wants to ban abortion nationwide. **Derek – Election Day is rapidly approaching** , and with our House majority on the line, we wanted to share 10 things that voters in PA-06 should know before casting their vote.
**Here's what you need to know about Guy Ciarrocchi, the man we CANNOT allow to replace Chrissy in office:**
1. **Guy Ciarrocchi is a right-wing extremist** who has been a conservative activist for decades, most recently running a failed campaign for governor of Pennsylvania.
2. Ciarrocchi has long pushed for Roe v. Wade to be overturned. He has worked to overturn the ruling and **restrict women’s rights** to make their own medical decisions. Thanks to him and his allies who helped to stack the Supreme Court, there is government-mandated pregnancy in multiple states across our country.
3. He has also backed right-wing policies to **disenfranchise voters** , calling for voter ID laws and criticizing early voting in September, ballot drop boxes, and mail-in ballots.
4. He has repeatedly **undermined our democracy**. In fact, discussing the 2020 election, he stated, “you don't have to work very hard to convince me that the Democrats cheat at elections."

Peter —

If you ask my family, friends and team about me, one thing you’ll probably hear pretty quickly is that I’m a straight shooter. After years on the bench as a judge and the former Chief Justice of North Carolina, it’s just my nature.

That mindset is what I think you deserve from your next U.S. Senator, and it’s how we’ve tried to run this campaign.

From the start of this campaign, we’ve tried to be as transparent as possible because there would be no campaign without the support of folks like you. That’s why we don’t do the fake “triple matches” or scare tactics you probably see elsewhere.

I want you to know that when we ask it’s because it’s important. It’s because I know that $10 and $25 at a time will make a difference.

And with our official FEC deadline coming up on the 17th, the reality is that we need to ask for a lot of help in the next 11 days. We’ve got our most ambitious goal ever, and the honest truth is we are significantly behind on our fundraising.

So I am humbly asking you today:

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tuberville for Senate, Inc
body:
I strongly oppose this change, and I’m demanding answers. Read more >>
| | | Peter, The U.S. Military’s Tricare health insurance has removed 15,000 small community pharmacies from its network. I strongly oppose this change, and I’m demanding answers in Washington. **[Read more here >>](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/c8e2774da8d4d6d3c3d6b838967d376c/33013/3e11e14cd8c4c83a/c34521cf5bb48e59c3d6b838967d376c/33013)** Many U.S. service members rely on local pharmacies, and with good reason. These community pharmacies are often less expensive and provide better health outcomes than big national chains. _Congress spends trillions each year on wasteful Big Government programs. It’s outrageous that we can’t find the funds to take care of those who have given so much to our country._ I will continue to fight this policy change. And I will always stand up for our active duty and retired service members in the U.S. Senate. Sincerely, Coach Tuberville

body:
Our campaign is relying on sustained support during this final sprint to take us to the next level.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=1030%2E61531%2Emal5Sp)
Team —
We wanted to make sure you saw this note from Ryan, our campaign manager here on Team Welch. With just under five weeks until the election, we’re giving it everything we’ve got—and are asking you to do the same. Republicans only need one seat to retake Senate control—and we can’t let it be Vermont.
Thanks,
Team Welch
\-------------- Begin original message --------------
From: Ryan McLaren
Subject: 5 weeks
Date: Tuesday, October 4, 2022
Hi there,
It’s Ryan, Peter’s campaign manager. As we approach the final five weeks of our campaign, I’ll be giving grassroots supporters like you weekly updates from here on out, and I’m sharing exactly why I’m on Team Welch.
**But before I dive into the details, I want to be upfront with you: five weeks isn’t a lot of time. Our campaign is relying on sustained support during this final sprint to take us to the next level. By making one gift per week, for the next five weeks, you’ll give us the certainty and the resources we need to make effective plans and to reach voters all across this state.**
[**Will you pledge to make a weekly recurring donation from now until November 8? This is how we ensure we have the grassroots power to scale this movement and send Peter to the Senate.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4492?t=3&akid=1030%2E61531%2Emal5Sp)
[DONATE WEEKLY ](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4492?t=9&t=10&akid=1030%2E61531%2Emal5Sp)
---
I’ve worked for Peter since 2015. So I’ve seen the kind of person he is and how he leads with Vermont values—by valuing the importance of community, listening, and focusing on the solutions, not who gets credit. And, I know this personally, because Peter’s been there for me in good times and bad, which is exactly how he’s shown up for his constituents as congressman. He’s always there with a kind word or handwritten note because that’s just who he is.
But it’s not serious all the time—Peter is also pretty fun to be around, both on the trail and in the office! You know him as your congressman, but here on Team Welch, he’s who I like to describe as the class clown—always joking around and hunting for snacks around the office. It’s really never a dull moment!
Peter has worked for the past 15 years to deliver on some of the most consequential problems working families are facing, like lowering prescription drug prices and confronting climate change. But I see just as much drive in him to help Vermonters now as I did the day I started working for him. That’s how I know we need his experience, and his Vermont values, in the U.S. Senate.
Our campaign is so much bigger than just this election. **To understand just how high the stakes are, just think: Republicans only need one seat to retake Senate control—and we can’t let it be Vermont.** We know we must win here in Vermont if we want to keep the Senate blue. If our Republican opponent wins, our entire progressive agenda will be on the line.
[**That’s why I’m asking (if you’re able) to make a five-week commitment to our campaign with a weekly recurring donation every week until Election Day. Anything you’re able to contribute—$5, $10, $25—will be a huge help to reach voters in a critical race like this.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4492?t=4&akid=1030%2E61531%2Emal5Sp)
[DONATE WEEKLY ](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4492?t=9&t=12&akid=1030%2E61531%2Emal5Sp)
---
Thank you so much for everything—and I’ll be in touch again next week.
Ryan McLaren
Campaign Manager, Welch for Vermont
[](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4492?t=5&akid=1030%2E61531%2Emal5Sp)
PS: We understand not everyone is able to give weekly. [**If you’re able, and you’d like to make a one-time contribution, you can do so here.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4493?t=6&akid=1030%2E61531%2Emal5Sp)

---

name: Candace Owens
subject: Hollywood = Satanic Values
body:
Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one h
[](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z3l9ne4l7ie5tvhn3ged0j8b8l2ir613r83do0qg_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1jm9oj2cjh2bs)
Friend,

Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to **sell?**

Because that's exactly what happened -- Kris Jenner watched AND hand-picked which sex tape her daughter Kim Kardashian would release!

**It is not an exaggeration to say that Hollywood is satanic.**

What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex?

If that disgusts you, here's where it gets worse. _It worked_. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire, and she's still selling sex.

She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you're willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more.

**Is this the example we want to leave for our children?**

At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence.

My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance.

I've set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don't have to be like the Kardashians to be successful.

[**Can you support this critical mission with a gift of $10, $25, or even $50? Click here to donate today >>>**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zfd5g9q2fviccs18is11d4ti3bb0ga2512msrd5o_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1jm9oj2cjh2bs)

BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters.

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies.

Just this summer, **BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people.** They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration.

**BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children** for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp.

The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland!

Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program - Liberation Camp - for 80 children.

_BLEXIT 's Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative_.

The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter **distributed over 400 school supplies** and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago's most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to **give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags.**

BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America's minority communities.

[**We currently have 42 chapters across the US and more than 14,000 volunteers! You can help BLEXIT support our State Chapters by donating $10, $25, $50, or any other amount today. Click here to send your gift >>>**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2znfra1v0khttstr272rp66gv629i63vd58ffhq28_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1jm9oj2cjh2bs)

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities.

These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them.

But here's the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community:

* They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities.

* They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers.

* They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves.

**These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.**

BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can't do it alone, Friend. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000?

I am extremely disturbed by the current state of politics. I see far too much partisanship and radicalization, especially in my party. What we need in Congress are leaders like Jeff Ettinger. ETTINGER FOR CONGRESS

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52098287/371230579/1425682023?refcode=header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzMwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOTk5NjVhZC1hMjQ1LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tzOGNOKr4gflt6IB_L2vsXFMzmuQGJ8ULeBaJd2yjPY=)
Hi friend,

As a former two-term Republican Governor of Minnesota, I recently sat down for a conversation with Jeff Ettinger to discuss the Inflation Reduction Act, the frightening extremism that is taking over the Republican Party, and how blind party loyalty is hurting our democracy as well as all of us. **[You can read the full conversation here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52098289/371230580/-2055865595?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzMwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOTk5NjVhZC1hMjQ1LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tzOGNOKr4gflt6IB_L2vsXFMzmuQGJ8ULeBaJd2yjPY=&emci=650bf866-9745-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=d99965ad-a245-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=5460736)**

Nowadays, for a Republican to even sit down with a Democrat is all too rare. But, it was not always that way. When I was Governor, the Legislature was controlled by the other party but we were able to get things done because we all worked together, reasoned together, and compromised. Neither side always got what it wanted, but we passed bills that bettered the lives of the people of Minnesota and that was what mattered most.

I am extremely disturbed by the current state of politics. I see far too much partisanship and radicalization, especially in my party. How dare anyone put party above country. What we need in Congress are leaders like Jeff Ettinger. **That is why, even though I used to be a proud Republican, I am supporting Jeff Ettinger for Congress. Our nation, our state, and our district need him.** **[Join me in supporting Jeff by chipping in to his campaign here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52098291/371230581/78570807?refcode=10-06-arne&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzMwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOTk5NjVhZC1hMjQ1LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tzOGNOKr4gflt6IB_L2vsXFMzmuQGJ8ULeBaJd2yjPY=)**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52098293/371230582/78570807?refcode=10-06-arne&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzMwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOTk5NjVhZC1hMjQ1LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=tzOGNOKr4gflt6IB_L2vsXFMzmuQGJ8ULeBaJd2yjPY=)
When I look at Brad Finstad, I see a man who, sadly, has chosen party over country time and again. Take the Inflation Reduction Act, for example. This is one of the most constructive pieces of legislation that I have seen in decades. However, Finstad voted against it simply because that was the party line. This kind of blind party loyalty and tribalism is not healthy for our democracy. This is particularly true when you consider the help this legislation will be providing to our district.

I know Jeff Ettinger and I trust him as a leader to do what is best for our state and country. We need leaders in Washington with his extensive business background. I am confident that when he gets elected to Congress, he will be called upon by the White House for his economic advice. He will be the only major CEO of an international company in Congress and his insights are invaluable.

**Jeff Ettinger’s business expertise and commitment to the people of Southern Minnesota are why so many moderate Republicans plan to support him in November.** It is also why what some may have thought to be a safe GOP district is now a “toss up.”
