ETTINGER FOR CONGRESS | = Hi friend, As a former two-term Republican Governor of Minnesota, I recently sat down for a conversation with Jeff Ettinger to discuss the Inflation Reduction Act, the frightening extremism that is taking over the Republican Party, and how blind party loyalty is hurting our democracy as well as all of us. Nowadays, for a Republican to even sit down with a Democrat is all too rare. But, it was not always that way. When I was Governor, the Legislature was controlled by the other party but we were able to get things done because we all worked together, reasoned together, and compromised. Neither side always got what it wanted, but we passed bills that bettered the lives of the people of Minnesota and that was what mattered most. I am extremely disturbed by the current state of politics. I see far too much partisanship and radicalization, especially in my party. How dare anyone put party above country. What we need in Congress are leaders like Jeff Ettinger. That is why, even though I used to be a proud Republican, I am supporting Jeff Ettinger for Congress. Our nation, our state, and our district need him. = = When I look at Brad Finstad, I see a man who, sadly, has chosen party over country time and again. Take the Inflation Reduction Act, for example. This is one of the most constructive pieces of legislation that I have seen in decades. However, Finstad voted against it simply because that was the party line. This kind of blind party loyalty and tribalism is not healthy for our democracy. This is particularly true when you consider the help this legislation will be providing to our district. I know Jeff Ettinger and I trust him as a leader to do what is best for our state and country. We need leaders in Washington with his extensive business background. I am confident that when he gets elected to Congress, he will be called upon by the White House for his economic advice. He will be the only major CEO of an international company in Congress and his insights are invaluable. Jeff Ettinger’s business expertise and commitment to the people of Southern Minnesota are why so many moderate Republicans plan to support him in November. Before I even became North Carolina's Democratic Senate nominee, the national Republicans were attacking me. I was the first challenger in the country the NRSC ran ads against, and my opponent’s super PAC allies are pumping nearly $50 million into this race.
It’s ridiculous. Not just the attacks, but the fact that billionaires and corporate special interests are legally allowed to spend limitless sums to try to buy an election like this.
Look, their super PACs can spend millions on false attack ads against me, like they’ve already done. But I refuse to back down because this seat and our next senator’s vote should not be for sale.
My opponent, Ted Budd, thinks he can just let special interests buy this seat for him, and in return, he’ll continue doing exactly what he’s done in Congress — voting to keep the system rigged in favor of billionaires and corporations. He will fight for a future where abortion is banned in every state and where marriage equality is overturned.
If you believe that we deserve a senator who puts people first, then I need you with me in this fight.

body:
It honestly means so much knowing that there are thousands of you out there chipping in to support me before I take the stage.
#

Friend —
I have something important to ask ahead of tonight’s debate and I hope you’ll give me a minute to explain why this is so important.
In just a few hours, I’m going to take the stage for a debate with my opponent, Blake Masters.
[**And before I do, I really need your support.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct22.7U3p1A&refcode=em221006-1-7&t=1&akid=4154%2E6688874%2EM20oJD)
This is one of the last chances for me to speak directly to Arizonans before voting begins, so it’s really important that we have a big day today.
And it honestly means so much knowing that there are thousands of you out there chipping in to support me before I take the stage.
But right now, my team tells me we still have some work to do to hit our goal. We need a surge of donations to help us get there before the debate begins.
**I’m hoping you can help however you can. If you’re able, you can use the link below to make a donation of any amount before the debate begins:**
[**https://act.markkelly.com/go/October-Debate**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct22.7U3p1A&refcode=em221006-1-7&t=2&akid=4154%2E6688874%2EM20oJD)
I hope that after I get off the stage, I can check back in and say we won the debate and hit our goal.
I can’t thank you enough for all of the hard work you’ve put into this campaign. I’m so humbled to have so many of you supporting us in these final weeks. It really makes all the difference knowing that I can count on you.
Full speed ahead!
\- Mark

Team – Kyrsten recently introduced the _National Park Foundation Reauthorization Act_ , a resolution that increases funding for the National Park Foundation, a nonprofit that works with parks all across the country to protect and preserve their landscapes and ecosystems. The _National Park Foundation Reauthorization Act_ is a bipartisan effort to extend funding through 2030 to protect our national parks, create outdoor recreation opportunities, boost tourism, and honor the cultural identity of tribal communities. Arizona is home to the best national parks in the country. That’s why Kyrsten has worked diligently to introduce legislation to protect our stunning outdoor spaces and boost our economy. | **We Don’t Have to Live This Way** We’ve all experienced it the last few weeks...skyrocketing gas prices...again.The Biden Administration claimed credit for the modest drop in prices last month, but accepts no blame for the recent increases. Americans are tired of this.Yesterday, OPEC announced they are cutting oil production by 2 million barrels per day. This reduces global supply by 2%!**We don’t have to live this way.** Elissa Slotkin has marched lock-step with Joe Biden, voting with him 100% of the time.The race for Michigan’s 7th District will determine control of Congress and if we win, I promise you things will change.This week, I launched this [new ad](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=633ee746f6ec3d00bedf2600&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Fad-gas&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&l=en-US&s=Q1gXfgfGHeUtM2tTNv6ymTXEg5Q%3D) focused on gas prices. | | The latest and most dangerous attempt to undermine our market and force a woke agenda on America is called the**Environmental, Social, And Governance Movement (ESG). **ESG rules are a dangerous form of red-tape regulation. Left-wing activists want to impose government ESG rules as a way to assert control over Wall Street and Main Street businesses. ESG has been commonly described by the Left as criteria for making investment decisions to “aid environmental or social causes you care about.” _But really, they only want it to benefit causes THEY care about. _ **_ESG is essentially a social credit score for businesses that would favor radical, liberal beliefs and PUNISH pro-American, traditional values._** _**[END ESG NOW>>](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zl9vnvulet88q7ob27h5d4prrqg2blr6b2eqvr6g_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1ge4o72c3h2bs)**_
---
| | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zqq60j4unuc5huo3dq5af3bm3gf8nqjs4renq8co_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1ge4o72c3h2bs)
---
| | **How will the Left punish companies with ESG?** With a low ESG score, companies may not qualify for loans or investments. The Left will use cancel-culture tactics to pressure other companies to cut business ties. Government contracts will only go to the “right” companies with the “right” ESG scores. The Left will deplatform companies from needed services—like banking, advertising, and internet services. **Who does ESG hurt?** Everyone! Customers, employees, small businesses, big businesses, investors, and anyone with a retirement account will suffer under an ESG regime. We’ve seen what socialist control of businesses looks like in China, Venezuela, the USSR—it’s not good! **What kind of companies would be punished under ESG?** American oil and gas companies. Companies that don’t pledge to go 100% green. Companies that fail to mandate CRT trainings for employees. Companies that don’t push “woke” gender ideology. The list goes on and on...And it's a BIG DEAL! Once you cross the Left, they will use ESG to target you. [_**As I wrote**_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zajnq4upm4srrjghea4uggglgn6hlpdv02s5rr90_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1ge4o72c3h2bs) in my op-ed, **Elon Musk found this out the hard way.** After his public stance on free speech and efforts to purchase Twitter, his “electric cars, solar, and clean energy” company was excluded from the ESG index. ESG is infecting every level of government and finance: last May, Biden’s pick to lead banking regulation said “the way we basically get rid of those carbon financiers is we starve them of their sources of capital." This is the heart of ESG — financially starving any companies who aren't in line with the progressive ideology. We've already watched as this administration has shuttered pipelines, denied permits, and cut off development-bank financing for oil and gas — all in line with the so-called ESG agenda. At Heritage Action, we're working to fight back and prevent the spread of ESG rules and regulations. Through education, activism, and legislation, we can fight ESG, just like we did CRT (Critical Race Theory). But we need your support to raise awareness and STOP ESG! **Will you join us by signing the petition to END ESG now?[_https://heritageaction.com/support/_](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z8v8sgf90tcvku5brb42e5g6l0c2vhj4p2sr07r8_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1ge4o72c3h2bs)** _ESG policies are nothing but a thinly veiled attempt to radically transform corporations into social justice warriors and exclude conservatives from competing in our economy._ We cannot allow this to continue.Make your voice heard by signing your name now.
---

subject: #TeamLizzie Weekly Update — 5 weeks to Election Day!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221005wu?refcode=lpfe221005wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221005wu?refcode=lpfe221005wu]
Election Day is right around the corner — we have a little more than a month left to execute all our get-out-the-vote efforts before the election and we need all the help we can get.
Here’s one way you can help: Come to our postcard party with Run Sister Run today, October 6 from 6 p.m. to 8 p.m. [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/518758/]
VOLUNTEER WITH US [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/518758/]
https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/518758/ [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/518758/]
And if you haven’t already, make sure you’re registered to vote, because Texas' deadline is this upcoming Tuesday, less than one week away.
Visit VoteTexas.org and make sure you and all the Texans you know are prepared to cast ballots this election. [https://www.votetexas.gov/register-to-vote/index.html?emci=de448417-2b23-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=90a97c57-3023-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=29495980]
With five weeks to go until Election Day, Lizzie and the team have been out and about across TX-07.
Last Saturday, we kicked off our Day of Action at our HQ. Thanks to all who showed up and helped get out the word about this crucial election!
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221005wu?refcode=lpfe221005wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221005wu?refcode=lpfe221005wu]
Last night, we loved seeing new parts of #TX07 at National Night Out! So fun to visit with people in Lazybrook, Montrose, and Midtown. We’ve also been spending time in Fort Bend County. Last week Lizzie joined County Commissioner Grady Prestage and many other community leaders in supporting the re-election of Fort Bend County Judge KP George. Like Lizzie, Judge George was elected in 2018 and he has worked tirelessly to move Fort Bend forward.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221005wu?refcode=lpfe221005wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221005wu?refcode=lpfe221005wu]
We were also glad to see so many friends and #TeamLizzie members at the Houston LGBTQ+ Political Caucus’ 13th Annual Equality Brunch.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221005wu?refcode=lpfe221005wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221005wu?refcode=lpfe221005wu]
Lizzie is a proud champion for our LGBTQ+ community in Congress. Her efforts to protect our freedoms and equality are especially critical during a time when there are serious threats to our privacy, autonomy, and dignity.
With five weeks to go, we aren’t slowing down. Save the date to join us for our next big Day of Action on October 22. We have one in Harris County [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/524791/] and another in Fort Bend County [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/524784/] . Don’t want to wait that long? Sign up to volunteer at your convenience here [https://lizziefletcher.com/volunteer] !
As a member of the Congressional Asian Pacific American Caucus, Lizzie has proudly worked with AAPI members of our community to promote equality, reject prejudice, and improve access to services for all.
She's glad to have earned the endorsement of the Houston 80-20 Asian-American Political Action Committee (PAC)!
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221005wu?refcode=lpfe221005wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221005wu?refcode=lpfe221005wu]
Thanks for being a part of the team,
Team Lizzie

Cheri wants to hear from you!
#
Tomorrow night is our first debate — and the only one Ted Budd would agree to.
Cheri is preparing for the debate right now and she wants to hear from you. There’s going to be a lot of ground to cover during this debate, and she wants to know what issues you care about most.
**[Will you take 2 minutes to complete our brief issues survey and share your input on the most important issues with Cheri before tomorrow’s debate?**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/signup/pre-debate-email-survey?source=em221006-1-MA&refcode2=1955.357359.VTYGmU&akid=1955%2E357359%2EVTYGmU)

This race is about more than one Senate seat. It’s a chance to elect the kind of leader North Carolinians deserve — someone who listens and gives a voice to people. This is about fighting for a brighter future for all of us — where everyone can thrive, no matter their ZIP code.
We have the opportunity to shake up the status quo. We can shift the balance of power away from the corporate interests that control Washington and back toward the people.
Ultimately, this is about you and your family. From the start, we have said everybody deserves a voice in this campaign and in the U.S. Senate.
So today, Cheri needs to hear what issues are top of mind for you right now.
**[What issues do you most want to hear about at tomorrow night’s debate? This should only take a minute to two of your time, but it will make a big impact.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/signup/pre-debate-email-survey?source=em221006-1-MA&refcode2=1955.357359.VTYGmU&akid=1955%2E357359%2EVTYGmU)

clean_body: It'll take electing more Democrats up and down the ballot to keep building a better America. | | Derek, I believe with every fiber of my being that there’s not a thing in the world America can’t do if we set our mind to it. Since taking office, we’ve fought to restore the soul of this nation, restore the middle class, and unite the country. We put hundreds of millions of shots in arms, passed one of the single largest investments in infrastructure in American history, and put the first African American woman, Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson, on the Supreme Court. Every bit of progress we’ve made has been possible because of folks on this grassroots team. But if MAGA Republicans win this year, women could lose the right to choose anywhere in America. The right to contraception and marriage equality -- the whole right to privacy -- could be at risk. We can’t let that happen. And I don’t believe we will. You’ve yet to make a donation this year, and I need you to commit to our party. Chip in $7 to help elect Democrats nationwide in 2022. Make no mistake: Your contributions help elect Democratic senators, House members, and local officials. Your first donation would make a huge impact on the DNC’s investments ahead of November and beyond. Thanks for everything you do, Joe Joseph R. body:
| |
---
| | | I get asked all the time - "Politics is a dirty business, why would you run for Senate?"

**My response is simple: I still believe in America.**

---
| | | [HELP ME SAVE AMERICA](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61532034:JmO8QxVNI:m:1:3331421248:CC8642A82EC1DD9DDD753B4C42D3A2CF:r "HELP ME SAVE AMERICA")
---

_**Not everyone knows this about me:**_

I was born to a single mother, I didn't know who my father was, and had to work hard to make something of myself.

I worked hard through college, serving my country as a Naval Officer in Iraq, and serving Nevada as Attorney General.

That's the American dream - hard work that pays off.

It’s hard to know where to begin, Derek. But this attack
involves building a catapult and launching watermelons with Adam’s face on
them. No, seriously.

Kash Patel, a former aide to Devin Nunes and chief of staff to Donald
Trump’s Acting Secretary of Defense, wrote a children’s book titled The
Plot Against the King — featuring characters such as “King Donald,”
“Hillary Queenton,” and one particular “shifty knight.” Who, you guessed
it, is supposed to be Adam Schiff.

Literally repackaging the Big Lie about the 2020 election into a
children’s book to indoctrinate kids.

Then, over the weekend, this MAGA cultist hosted a children’s event to
promote his new book — an event featuring a castle, a catapult, and
watermelons adorned with, you guessed it, Adam’s likeness. See for
yourself:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2022_abs_em.ghQTJ3&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC_20221006_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=1037%2E5257348%2E2c4fDT ]Watermelon and catapult

The MAGA guests then launched the “watermelon heads” towards the castle
(which, by the way is what they did during the Medieval Ages with real
heads):

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2022_abs_em.ghQTJ3&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC_20221006_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=1037%2E5257348%2E2c4fDT ]Catapult throwing watermelon

Derek, hasn’t this all gotten totally out of hand? The hero
worship of Trump, elevating him from above the presidency to a monarch, is
one thing.

Launching literal depictions of Adam’s decapitated head towards castles?
It’s sick, and it’s wrong, and if it encourages violence, they just don’t
give a damn. Look at what Trump said of Mitch McConnell this week, the
incitement to violence is real.

But the more Trump’s supporters praise him and attack his enemies, the
greater their financial rewards in MAGA world, their status, and their
platform in media.

It’s a cult of personality. And it must be stopped.

Friend, my team and I are about to hold a critical strategy meeting - but we still need 37 more responses to my survey (below) before we can meet.
---
With Election Day just _weeks_ away, this is the last and most important opportunity for you to weigh in on our campaign strategy to win this crucial race. Mitch McConnell only needs to flip _one seat_ to take control of the Senate- and the national GOP has made me a target for defeat. That means I absolutely need the input of every last grassroots supporter.
**[So please, take just 60 seconds to complete this final priorities survey before the election.](https://surveys.signforgood.com/blumenthal-oct-prio-2022?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500&code=jtk1267-su-nd)**
Thank you,
Dick
\---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: **Richard Blumenthal**
Date: Tue, Oct 4, 2022
Subject: Last chance to give your input before Election Day (new survey enclosed)
[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=Xt6pbuScE5lQT0ZGM5GJx0MnKLaGnm3x&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
This is it, Friend. Election Day is almost exactly one month away.
The stakes couldn't be higher: If Republicans flip just one Democratic seat, they'll take back control of the Senate - where they'd use their majority to pass a nationwide ban on abortion and stop President Biden's agenda in its tracks.
**That 's why my campaign is ramping up our efforts to protect this must-win seat and defend Democratic control of the Senate. I needed to reach out to you personally to get your feedback on our campaign strategy at this critical moment.**
**[So please: Will you take a moment to share your top priorities and concerns with me as we move into the toughest part of this campaign? My team just put together this quick survey, and I'm counting on 67 more grassroots supporters to respond before we review this feedback.](https://surveys.signforgood.com/blumenthal-oct-prio-2022?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500&code=jtk1267-su-nd)**
To be honest with you, Friend, your input at this critical time couldn't be more important.
I'm facing Trump's hand-picked opponent, and as I continue to stand up relentlessly to the extremism of Trump and McConnell's Republican Party, I've become a target for GOP attacks. With Senate control at stake, I need to ensure we are executing the best possible campaign strategy - and that requires input from people like you.
**[So please, ahead of our next campaign strategy meeting this week, will you take our campaign's newest (and most important) strategy survey?](https://surveys.signforgood.com/blumenthal-oct-prio-2022?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500&code=jtk1267-su-nd)**

Dick

body:
I wanted to share these special moments with you.

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=e906fbd031174cafbd44bbf4b4f82f2a&_e=INOB7q2EkuQB-AjEq4MgdO6cF1PYqDJGtsUVHKQU-GKbzJH1vtT8j7fF5PCPHLrv86ZQq7a00tNq3bMeDQgf0Xa2RD1odEBDlPbYEKcB2XYda49TdNLX4tsBvIGvQyYxbp-IHVIHDE-Kyh6dFYAqhwRjlx2MGEBLpjGu1y1cQl5IqRyCXjZ7LwRRL45nyGtxPAC9AwquOH2HMdFLweM90EC-JP5DRpOjDwM0aNhKNeZHlhQbvQ_ttNDMmFv-A4G1G0KQJ03faM29PjjTdudUpVQw74nLI7Pwl_ulrw0WGPKcdFL9yEng7oJGTgSv1LGgY2iwkD8usovAo7CHK8tO9paNDjq7BHrOo8lzjQweKhiBk-C4i7s__5b9JE_QWr_Jvtm8aqDuX_rk4WUOZ1l-imlzEcymqJfU-_IrD6m4kcZIc9_6wRDavkgAriMTk0wI "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=e906fbd031174cafbd44bbf4b4f82f2a&_e=INOB7q2EkuQB-AjEq4MgdO6cF1PYqDJGtsUVHKQU-GKbzJH1vtT8j7fF5PCPHLrv86ZQq7a00tNq3bMeDQgf0Xa2RD1odEBDlPbYEKcB2XYda49TdNLX4tsBvIGvQyYxbp-IHVIHDE-Kyh6dFYAqhwRjlx2MGEBLpjGu1y1cQl5IqRyCXjZ7LwRRL45nyGtxPAC9AwquOH2HMdFLweM90EC-JP5DRpOjDwM0aNhKNeZHlhQbvQ_ttNDMmFv-A4G1G0KQJ03faM29PjjTdudUpVQw74nLI7Pwl_ulrw0WGPIAFV9QeoVZvqKTCRIAdluYidnCQiwid_kPkafxQYEAbXjvrD6exTwqqLyNPoW_SytH-lhn_g27pJZQnJjmGPYJB_g7J4BUt0A0k8Q8hxvvSAeIzsvdtdxAKheyjRT7H3rdzdQKa586s5NBl1FUmvDH "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=e906fbd031174cafbd44bbf4b4f82f2a&_e=INOB7q2EkuQB-AjEq4MgdO6cF1PYqDJGtsUVHKQU-GKbzJH1vtT8j7fF5PCPHLrv86ZQq7a00tNq3bMeDQgf0Xa2RD1odEBDlPbYEKcB2XYda49TdNLX4tsBvIGvQyYxbp-IHVIHDE-Kyh6dFYAqhwRjlx2MGEBLpjGu1y1cQl5IqRyCXjZ7LwRRL45nyGtxPAC9AwquOH2HMdFLweM90EC-JP5DRpOjDwM0aNhKNeZHlhQbvQ_ttNDMmFv-A4G1G0KQJ03faM29PjjTdudUpVQw74nLI7Pwl_ulrw0WGPIfomL9ytc5krUQwCURmQQGruUmpdeCccAjwZh5CHe5Cst4QQz-Ow4WeKtDNSnapgkKXzsRBtJIHTWXtqTnxjClZmxDRxVggt1IJXOoN8xvnSRmuJQ6YhYIo8h7Tm0hHYD553yEvICtu8SMiC2-eHQI "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty’s side.

---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=e906fbd031174cafbd44bbf4b4f82f2a&_e=INOB7q2EkuQB-AjEq4MgdO6cF1PYqDJGtsUVHKQU-GKbzJH1vtT8j7fF5PCPHLrv86ZQq7a00tNq3bMeDQgf0Xa2RD1odEBDlPbYEKcB2XYda49TdNLX4tsBvIGvQyYxbp-IHVIHDE-Kyh6dFYAqhwRjlx2MGEBLpjGu1y1cQl5IqRyCXjZ7LwRRL45nyGtxPAC9AwquOH2HMdFLweM90EC-JP5DRpOjDwM0aNhKNeZHlhQbvQ_ttNDMmFv-A4G1G0KQJ03faM29PjjTdudUpVQw74nLI7Pwl_ulrw0WGPJaWcs_WRGXnTrBc0plISGHd5vmTrT8vP33qd-aeeOLVn96tTZYK2fNB_MNZHl8ItA11ZbuCKcmggg1y0MCZxZuib5MioF5ONAaA3Q1kbWS8gx54MJFine57UDY-Y-4_Ck51qbTJEyMtYKa3VE_rLOj "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty’s immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_

name: Tom Fitton
subject: We Can’t Stop Now!
body:
You have an enormous stake in helping protect the honesty and integrity of American elections...the linchpin of our Republic.

| |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

In this last quarter of the year, we continue to take on **_more lawsuits_ , _more investigations_** and **_more public education_** on behalf of the rule of law.
And we are winning lawsuits and breaking new ground fighting for the principle "Because no one is above the law!"
We are doing all of this at a very important time for our nation. So I am especially thankful for your past help..**_and that’s why I am urgently reaching out to you today!_**
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60531&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

[I’m asking you to give your support to Judicial Watch today with contribution today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60531&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE) to help finance our investigations and lawsuits **_fighting for honest elections_** , **exposing taxpayer funding of** **Critical Race Theory** propaganda, **defending _conservative free speech_** , **_taking on illegal immigration_** _,_ and **_suing government agencies_** in federal and state courts for secret documents about **Biden family corruption.**

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60531&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

Here are a few specifics:

* **We are suing Colorado, New York and Pennsylvania for failing to obey federal law requiring they take reasonable steps to keep their voter registration rolls accurate**. "Dirty" voter rolls are an open invitation to voter fraud, and our election law team is now reviewing federal voter data with an eye to _challenging even more states_ over their failure to remove ineligible and inactive names between elections.

* **We are exposing the unprecedented attack on the rule of law by the Biden administration 's REFUSAL to enforce our immigration laws**.

* **_We are using state open records laws_ to expose the widespread misuse of _taxpayer dollars_ to indoctrinate public school students in the Marxist, racist and truly un-American Critical Race Theory (CRT).** We also forced the release of documents revealing that even the U.S. Military Academy at West Point is pushing CRT propaganda; and we have also filed FOIA lawsuits against the Defense Department for documents related to alleged **CRT** instruction at the U.S. Naval Academy and the U.S. Air Force Academy.

* **_We are fighting for the free speech rights of conservatives_** , including filing civil rights lawsuits on behalf of teachers fired from their jobs solely because they criticized CRT and other extreme programs. _And we recently won a settlement on behalf of one of our teacher clients in Massachusetts_!

[You can see why I'm asking for your special and urgent help.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60531&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE) Indeed, we just filed our sixth active federal lawsuit investigating serious allegations of **Biden** **family corruption** , centered around sleazy overseas influence-peddling schemes engineered by **Hunter Biden** that evidence shows benefitted his father, **Joe Biden**.

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60531&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

You can see why I want to be sure we have the resources to deliver on these and other ongoing important, history-making, anti-corruption investigations and lawsuits.

It is this level of commitment to the rule of law that has made **Judicial Watch** America's preeminent government watchdog.

Now our nation needs us even more, and _[I am counting onyou to join our cause](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60531&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)_. Our work has never been more important - _or urgent_! Thank you for whatever you can give now...

Sincerely,

Tom Fitton
President

subject: Become a Super Spreader!
body:
The Courtney Geels campaign is in need of social media partners to help spread the word about what Courtney stands for and bring new eyes, fans and followers to her social media pages. The goal is to expand her reach to as many voters who are on social media in her “universe.”

If you’re already a “super spreader” or if you would like to be one - we’d love to send you exclusive graphics and images to share on your socials, as well as help us boost specific social media posts!

If this sounds like something you are interested in doing, directly email our NEW social media coordinator at [contact@bluemeraldmedia.com](mailto:contact@bluemeraldmedia.com)

Time Commitment: You will be receiving a weekly email for the next 3 weeks with 1 exclusive graphic to share on social media (Facebook, Instagram or Twitter). Additionally, we will note specific posts that we would like to see extra interaction with (likes, comments and shares). NOTE: You do not have to be available every time.
Thank You for all your help!

__Fighting for Truth, Justice and Unity Together!__
Laurie Teper
Volunteer Director
Courtney Geels for Congress NC04

Can you please rush in a donation so our volunteers have everything they need from clipboard and pens to campaign literature?](https://act.myngp.com/el/v6FUxj7eqGU5U0ClYRwObuSaxglhp3pQTRmgkUSp064=/DBUeibzXa7MmBAGFfC0qlXUeRyVKeSzpO9dU6Su2P3g=?refcode=E18665-20221006-FieldStrategy-SL-Other-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=25) [](https://act.myngp.com/el/v6FUxj7eqGU5U0ClYRwObuSaxglhp3pQTRmgkUSp064=/DBUeibzXa7MmBAGFfC0qlXUeRyVKeSzpO9dU6Su2P3g=?refcode=E18665-20221006-FieldStrategy-graphic-Other-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=25) Our field strategy is simple (but not easy). We know that the best way to persuade an undecided voter is to talk with them face to face. So, we've spent the past year building volunteer teams that will talk to their neighbors about why we need Josh in office. This includes knocking doors, house parties, phone calls - you name it and we have a volunteer team doing it! It's so important we tell voters about Josh _now_ since ballots are officially in the hands of voters. We cannot let them be misled by the lies our MAGA opponent is spreading. | Peter
There are some facts that every voter should know about Nevada's far-left Governor who Sheriff Joe Lombardo is running to unseat.
Steve Sisolak's time in power has been riddled with corruption, scandals, and failures - in fact, he just might be the Worst Governor in America!
He wouldn't let our kids attend school without masks until he got approval from Gavin Newsom, tried to blame the police for his own failure to keep us safe, and even shuttered 95,000 small businesses for good with his heavy-handed response to COVID-19 (which got a "D" rating from the National Bureau of Economic Research).
Oh yeah - and did we mention he presided over one of the worst scandals in state history? Sisolak fast-tracked Northshore - the COVID testing lab associated with a MAJOR campaign donor of his - only for a majority of their tests not to work. Then he tried to cover it up until he got caught in a news investigation. This isn't us just saying it, Peter - you can look all this up.
But what's really concerning is just how shameless Sisolak's D.C. donors have been by coming to his defense. They even tried to rig the Republican primary in order to give Northshore Steve a weaker opponent - and now, they could use their millions to try to cover up all of his scandals. This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in.
[View this message in your browser](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z00o1lm6gqbhoruuapuh7baq0oou92vd398mn3t0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t56ej3fctmekp76t1heipnacpne4pqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65tb1mqon2t5m6eon3dr6emo6actk6tgb4plhc1j6eo316tir2sj4c4q66chgm1gefkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3cup7aphkcsqj8o3im9j3ao5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash1k8gn48n24hhm6pb0c3gecoj1c8iv0)

|
---
| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z0j2dtdr9oadf0fdf7gaoor699o4r7p719i93v50_rp22sh2s8i66or5c1ge1pj2c5h2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

| | Dear Friend of Liberty, Michael and Chantell Sackett have been fighting for 15 years to build a home on the private property they own near Priest Lake in Bonner County, Idaho. It’s not for the usual reasons like a lack of building supplies or unresponsive contractors. It’s because the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) declared that their land is a wetland. But here’s the kicker. The Sacketts’ land is not wet. There’s no water on it! Still, the government is going after them. And if the couple doesn’t comply with the EPA’s outlandish regulations, they could face fines up to $32,500 _per day_! The Sacketts have been dragged through the courts for years fighting for their property rights—**and yours**. Now, their case will be argued before the U.S. Supreme Court. And MSLF has lent them support in their fight against this blatant government overreach. That’s why I’m emailing you today with a special request. I’m hoping you will stand with the Sacketts and show them you support their fight by signing our petition today. If the EPA is allowed to trample the lives of private citizens like the Sacketts with no opposition, there’s no telling who could be next. But your voice today will push back against this injustice and show the government that you stand for freedom and the private property rights of every American citizen. **Please sign the petition below declaring your desire to stand against this blatant overreach by the EPA.**
* I am standing for the private property rights of Michael and Chantell Sackett.
* I am standing against unelected bureaucracies that threaten the rights of individual citizens.
* I am asking the U.S. Supreme Court to rule against the EPA’s blatant government overreach.

Please sign our petition right now at this secure link: **[https://mslegal.org/subscribe/sackett-petition/](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=1d5c43ded4ec4b8c8591b491dc8959d3&_e=nYWKYzmeBv7lR2yEe4VsueGFxf6A9gyMjZxGbbQ19K4cwnW9NWvcYNtVP0UcdhnOVinV-kwFvzY5jSBBTItLstMdruuoWcXR8TED1tDdZacjrG4lBQT4rP2fiYbO1ZGpU_XDX0qqNpkxn8CRzD6dqMgmEOW_a78AeFZCfVtpczJ_L4mJ4ZaBMhkD_29pk-qXhLj7a0CJEmCglBzFWC1XAeEk0iEEKmgrbX7Bngfu6IMMejy_9glmp2DJrBNbbMybwTo25UVMoNAgCNfnAtjR7Piv-wDzzzkO_aYkxidTfBjKZz6Ef5w4bnVZh2SCj32za-EIaFuow4XiDSd3RTKDiAisJvTarQFP7Pk6u3baznc%3D)** For Liberty! name: Rep. Dana Criswell
subject: Oppose Childhood Genital Mutilation
body:
Mississippi Freedom Caucus Opposes AMA Childhood Genital Mutilation Policy This week the Mississippi Freedom Caucus joined forces with state freedom caucuses across the nation to oppose the Americ | |
---

| | | Mississippi Freedom Caucus Opposes AMA Childhood Genital Mutilation Policy |
---|---|---
| This week the Mississippi Freedom Caucus joined forces with state freedom caucuses across the nation to oppose the American Medical Association (AMA), the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP), and the Children's Hospital Association (CHA) policy supporting childhood genital mutilation. The letter states:
> _Now, with your advocacy of childhood genital mutilation, your call to investigate those who disagree with you, and your request for Big Tech to suppress constitutionally protected free speech that challenges your leftist ideology, you have lost whatever credibility you had left._
The letter further explains:
> Furthermore, it is incredibly alarming that many of these atrocities are occurring at taxpayer-funded medical institutions. As members of the State Freedom Caucus Network and our state legislatures, we unequivocally declare that these procedures are outside the scope of the proper use of funds we have allocated to our respective hospitals. We will fulfill our duty to stand in the gap and stop harm to any child by unnatural and irreversible procedures. As state legislators, we are particularly charged with ensuring taxpayer-funded institutions take no part in furthering ethically and morally repugnant agendas inconsistent with the values of our states.Collectively, and across the country, we will be pursuing a path to ensure no minors can receive these barbaric procedures. This includes calling on our governors to denounce this practice and using all available tools to end it. If proven non-compliant, these facilities will face repercussions for practices inconsistent with the values of the citizens of our states. This mutilation cannot and will not be tolerated in any form.
The Mississippi Freedom Caucus is the only organized group of legislators standing against this leftist agenda. We will stand firm in our effort to protect the children of Mississippi.|
---
---

subject: a flat out lie
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC
body:
|
---
Peter,

**The Left is so desperate to hold their majority in the Senate, they're willing to do anything to win this seat in Georgia - including lie.**

They want to make this race about anything except what the true problems are in this country: inflation, a wide-open border, and crime. They don't want to talk about the real issues, so they make up lies about me.

Now, a liberal publication is claiming that I paid for a woman to have an abortion. **This is a flat-out lie - and I deny this in the strongest possible terms.**

This is another repugnant hatchet job from a Democrat activist, disguised as a reporter, who has obsessively attacked my family and tried to tear me down since this race started. He's harassed friends of mine, asking if I fathered their children. He's called my children 'secret' because I didn't want to use them as campaign props in a political campaign. Now, they're using an anonymous source to further slander me.

_**They will do anything to hold onto power. It's disgusting, gutter politics.**_

**I'm not taking this anymore. I am planning to sue the Daily Beast for this defamatory lie.**

Now you know how important this Senate seat is.

I knew what I was getting into when I signed up to run in this race. After what the Left did to destroy Justice Brett Kavanaugh's life when the Supreme Court was on the line, I knew they'd come after me too because control of the Senate is on the line.

They think they can threaten me. They think they can scare me. Right now, all they've done is energize me more.

_**[I'm going to fight and win this seat for the great people of Georgia, but I need you to stand with me.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61515911:Jvi61xVNK:m:1:3334294963:5F108125A25CB0399F04DC141D0093D3:r)**_

The Left needs this Georgia seat to maintain their power, but we're not going to let them have it. If they take this seat, we won't recognize this country tomorrow.

What they're doing to me - and other candidates - is not right.

**[They are desperate to win these Senate seats because they want to change this country, but we're not going to let it happen.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61515911:Jvi61xVNK:m:1:3334294963:5F108125A25CB0399F04DC141D0093D3:r)**

We have tremendous problems in this country, and we need new leadership in Washington. The Left will try to buy seats, lie, and do whatever they can to get us off our game. But their attacks have made me ready to fight even harder now.

Peter, control of the U.S. Senate is on the line, and the future of America is at risk. **[Will you stand with me in these final weeks of the campaign?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61515911:Jvi61xVNK:m:1:3334294963:5F108125A25CB0399F04DC141D0093D3:r)**

Sincerely,

Herschel Walker

name: Val Demings
subject: I wanted to tell you this personally
body:
Derek –
You're a key part of this movement, so I wanted you to be the first to know this:
For months, polls have shown me behind Marco Rubio – but after we outraised him nearly 3 to 1 in a previous quarter, a brand-new poll shows us TIED, 46-46!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP13/1/87591/images/ezgif.com-gif-maker.gif]
Thank you for helping me give Marco Rubio the toughest fight of his career.
And now I'll be up-front about where we stand: I'm 1 point down in recent polls, and once again I'm counting on this powerful grassroots team to help with the resources I need to surge ahead in these final weeks. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_vd?refcode=20221006_CGVA_Demings]
In the last few months, polls have showed me neck and neck in a race that could decide Senate control – and I never could have made this incredible progress without supporters like you.
Here's the problem: Marco Rubio and Mitch McConnell just spent $1.3 million on TV ads in key areas of Florida to take back the lead, and there's no doubt national Republican PACs will pour even more money into attack ads against me when they see this week's polls.
I clearly have momentum on my side – but with the GOP running ads that misrepresent me and everything I stand for, I need to make serious investments in voter outreach immediately.
I need to raise $50,000 before midnight to counter GOP attacks. It's the ONLY way to take the lead in what's shaping up to be the most expensive Senate race in the country – so I'm really counting on you to give.
I can't flip Florida blue and protect our Democratic Senate majority without your support, so I'm respectfully asking: If you believe in this campaign and have $25 to give, will you PLEASE split a contribution between my campaign and CommonGood today? REMINDER - TONIGHT: Join Congressional Hispanic Caucus Chair Dr. Raul Ruiz (D-CA) and me on our Weekly Grassroots Volunteer Update for #HispanicHeritageMonth, as we celebrate the progress Democrats delivered on jobs, health care, climate and lower costs — and our plans to defeat Republicans who restrict freedoms, block DACA and embrace anti-immigrant cruelty.

Join us:
https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/1016437740912/WN_zPE4Q9X5QGCZ53MwEQ6WdQ

---

Dear Friends,

Less than 5 weeks from securing our great Democratic victory on November 8th and with early voting happening across America over the next few weeks, YOU have a key role to play in getting out a record vote to hold our Democratic House. For up-to-the-minute updates, please be sure to follow me at https://twitter.com/TeamPelosi.

As we continue our celebration of Hispanic Heritage Month, I am thrilled that we will be joined TONIGHT at 4PM PT / 7PM ET for this week’s Grassroots Volunteer Update by my great colleague and fellow Californian, the Chair of the Congressional Hispanic Caucus – Rep. Raul Ruiz, MD. Chair Ruiz will discuss how Latino voters were instrumental in Democrats’ successes in 2018 and 2020 — and the work Democrats are doing to deliver for Hispanic and Latino communities.

Join our conversation. RSVP:

https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/1016437740912/WN_zPE4Q9X5QGCZ53MwEQ6WdQ

In the Congress, Dr. Ruiz represents California’s 36th District – the home of Coachella. He is the proud son of farm workers whose community helped pay for his education, lifting him to three Harvard degrees. Dr. Ruiz serves on the Energy & Commerce and Veterans' Affairs committees. An unmatched hero for public health, Dr. Ruiz was an indispensable intellectual resource in our success in crafting and enacting the PACT Act, giving cancer care to veterans exposed to toxic burn pits and Agent Orange, and for our military families exposed to contaminated water at Camp Lejeune in North Carolina. A man of his word who promised he would always give back to the community that believed in him, Dr. Ruiz continues to pay it forward by changing lives from Mexico to Serbia to Haiti and, to this day, in the Emergency Room as he takes a shift when he is back home.

Under Chair Ruiz’s leadership, the Congressional Hispanic Caucus has prioritized equitable distribution of covid relief, infrastructure investments, and the inflation reduction law; secured jobs and environmental justice protections for frontline communities; supported investments in education, including Hispanic Serving Institutions and bigger Pell Grants; and lowered costs and increased access to health care.

As always, thank you for all you do as our VIPs – our volunteers in politics — who put us in power to deliver For The People.
NANCY

Nancy Pelosi is the Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives.
As the top Democrat in the House, she's fighting to help working families and protect America from the dangerous agenda of Mitch McConnell and Kevin McCarthy.
We know you're getting a lot of emails -- but it's only because what we're facing right now as a country is so important.
Nancy is committed to doing whatever it takes to elect a record-breaking number of Democrats in the next election and beyond. Can we count on your support?

| **Senator Bryce Reeves Drafts Legislation to Repeal SB1387, a Bill Which Gives Illegal Immigrants In-State Tuition Rates**
---
| **FREDERICKSBURG, VA- Oct. 6, 2022:** Today, Senator Bryce Reeves (R-Spotsylvania) began the drafting process of a bill to repeal [SB1387(Boysko)](https://f1v3ff69.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flis.virginia.gov%2Fcgi-bin%2Flegp604.exe%3F212%2Bful%2BCHAP0108/1/01000183ae91318d-b58fd9c1-90d3-4b2e-b094-b7c19861b540-000000/OyWQPHUevyWg5RSTF7UdS7OlMTI=290)/[HB2123(Lopez)](https://f1v3ff69.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flis.virginia.gov%2Fcgi-bin%2Flegp604.exe%3F212%2Bful%2BCHAP0107/1/01000183ae91318d-b58fd9c1-90d3-4b2e-b094-b7c19861b540-000000/SGMuNmg2M5Z-C-F-djkLRBif2n4=290) of the 2021 Special Session. SB1387, as it stands, grants in-state tuition rates to illegal migrants residing within the Commonwealth. The bill, signed into law by former Governor Northam (D-Virginia) in March of 2021, currently provides individuals in-state tuition rates regardless of their legal status in the US, as well as access to financial assistance from VA Universities and other sources. Reeves said, “We are in the midst of a higher education cost crisis caused by the federal government's continued involvement in the student loan process. To think that we would prioritize students that are here illegally over our country's own citizens is astounding. All this does is decrease the pool of scholarships and funds available to law-abiding US citizens who reside in Virginia, worsening the issues that our youth face today when it comes to the accessibility of higher education. To support this legislation would feel like turning my back on my constituents. I am committed to repealing this unethical, irresponsible law.” A father of two, Senator Reeves continued, “The idea that my own child might be denied entrance to a Virginia University because their acceptance slots have been filled by individuals who have violated a multitude of federal laws is infuriating. I cannot begin to imagine the pain and frustration fellow parents are feeling around the Commonwealth, especially as we enter this year's application period for many VA universities.” Many Virginia parents are already fed up with the state of Virginia public school systems at all levels, having to advocate for basic parental rights that have been enshrined in the Virginia code since 2013 with the passage of [SB908(Reeves)](https://f1v3ff69.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flis.virginia.gov%2Fcgi-bin%2Flegp604.exe%3F131%2Bful%2BCHAP0678/1/01000183ae91318d-b58fd9c1-90d3-4b2e-b094-b7c19861b540-000000/OuItOGW4V8ZZJnzgQQRo0iBOIR4=290).
---
| ###
---
| Bryce Reeves is a small business owner, auxiliary sheriff's deputy in Culpeper County, former Army Ranger, and former Prince William County narcotics detective. He currently represents the 17th District in the Virginia Senate, which includes the City of Fredericksburg and the Counties of Albemarle (part), Culpeper (part), Louisa (part), Orange, and Spotsylvania (part). Senator Reeves serves on the Senate Committee on Rehabilitation and Social Services and sits on the Committees on Local Government, General Laws and Technology, and Privileges and Elections. In addition, Senator Reeves is Co-chair of the Virginia General Assembly Military and Veterans Caucus. Senator Reeves resides in Spotsylvania County.

SB1387, as it stands, grants in-state tuition rates to illegal migrants residing within the Commonwealth. The bill, signed into law by former Governor Northam (D-Virginia) in March of 2021, currently provides individuals in-state tuition rates regardless of their legal status in the US, as well as access to financial assistance from VA Universities and other sources. Reeves said, “We are in the midst of a higher education cost crisis caused by the federal government's continued involvement in the student loan process. To think that we would prioritize students that are here illegally over our country's own citizens is astounding. All this does is decrease the pool of scholarships and funds available to law-abiding US citizens who reside in Virginia, worsening the issues that our youth face today when it comes to the accessibility of higher education. To support this legislation would feel like turning my back on my constituents. I am committed to repealing this unethical, irresponsible law.” A father of two, Senator Reeves continued, “The idea that my own child might be denied entrance to a Virginia University because their acceptance slots have been filled by individuals who have violated a multitude of federal laws is infuriating. I cannot begin to imagine the pain and frustration fellow parents are feeling around the Commonwealth, especially as we enter this year's application period for many VA universities.” Many Virginia parents are already fed up with the state of Virginia public school systems at all levels, having to advocate for basic parental rights that have been enshrined in the Virginia code since 2013 with the passage of . | ### | Bryce Reeves is a small business owner, auxiliary sheriff's deputy in Culpeper County, former Army Ranger, and former Prince William County narcotics detective. He currently represents the 17th District in the Virginia Senate, which includes the City of Fredericksburg and the Counties of Albemarle (part), Culpeper (part), Louisa (part), Orange, and Spotsylvania (part). Senator Reeves serves on the Senate Committee on Rehabilitation and Social Services and sits on the Committees on Local Government, General Laws and Technology, and Privileges and Elections. In addition, Senator Reeves is Co-chair of the Virginia General Assembly Military and Veterans Caucus. | | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52117475/371276986/-1829049351?refcode=mh-jtk1779-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OTIwYzk2Ni1jNjQ1LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qtFnSGniUfzkcnjwVt7wSUVz25zmEheC0s1-OSrJodk=)

My name is Margaret Wood Hassan. Some people call me “Senator,” two very special ones call me “mom” (more on that in a second), but most just call me Maggie. You might already know a bit about me and what I stand for. **[If you do, I hope you’ll take a second to give even just $3 to my reelection campaign.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52117476/371276987/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1779-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OTIwYzk2Ni1jNjQ1LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qtFnSGniUfzkcnjwVt7wSUVz25zmEheC0s1-OSrJodk=)** But no matter how much you know about me, with plenty of new folks joining this grassroots team, I thought I would take a moment to reintroduce myself. So...
Hi folks – I’m Maggie, and I’m facing election-denier, Don Bolduc, in one of the top battleground Senate races of 2022. With just under five weeks left until Election Day, I wanted to share five things about myself with you:
1\. Before I was an elected **anything** , I was a mom: I’ve been a State Senator, Governor, and U.S. Senator, but before I began my life in public service I had my two wonderful kids – Meg and Ben. Advocating for kids like my son Ben, who has cerebral palsy, was part of what led me into public service in the first place.
2\. I’m one of **four** Margarets: My grandmother was Margaret Cooke Byers, my mother is Peggy Byers Wood, I’m Maggie Wood Hassan, and my daughter is Meg. I stand on the shoulders of each Margaret (and every woman) that came before me, and I’m committed to making a better world for young women like my own daughter Meg.
3\. In college, I played rugby: While I’m glad that politics is only a full contact sport _metaphorically_ , the teamwork and toughness rugby taught me are skills I carry with me to this day.
4\. I do the New York Times Mini crossword puzzle every morning: And sometimes I even compete with my colleagues like Amy Klobuchar.
5\. 1,017 is a number I’ve got memorized: That’s how many votes we won this seat by in 2016. Without those 1,017 votes, we wouldn’t have saved the ACA or passed the Inflation Reduction Act, so I’m incredibly proud of that number. But I’m also acutely aware of the fact that it’s the slimmest margin of any sitting U.S. Senator. I end with this fact because it is not just about me, it is about all of us. That razor-thin margin is proof that holding this seat won’t be easy. **I’ve won tough fights before, but it always takes teamwork – so, friend, I hope you’ll join my team today.**
Now that you know a little more about me friend, I hope I can count on your support, because my team needs you more than ever.

Social Security is a beloved and enormously popular program. The majority of seniors and those with disabilities depend on it to get by.

Republican Senators have suggested that Social Security can’t be saved and should be put up for a reauthorization vote annually or every few years or even privatizing the program (which means profiteers will find ways to enrich themselves at the expense of the program).

**Democrats like Derek Marshall are working to save Social Security by making the wealthy pay their fair share.**

[**Stand with Derek and sign the petition to protect and expand Social Security.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52103675/371235282/553286158?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODEyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMzYwODVlMS1hNjQ1LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xj8AUkTY33Ngvr8KD2Rg5eYeKkE0hfqE4E15uizIIJk=&emci=df95fc5b-ad44-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=236085e1-a645-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=21617867)

It seems as though Republicans are telling us, quite accurately, what they will do if they retake power.

Putting Social Security on the chopping block every year or so won’t help working families or retirees as the Republicans would have you believe. It would devastate them.

**Extreme MAGA Republicans don’t have a plan to help with kitchen table issues. Meanwhile, Democrats are working to safeguard Social Security WHILE reducing the deficit, healthcare costs, and energy costs.

[The future of Social Security depends on YOU! Sign the petition: protect and expand Social Security now!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52103676/371235283/553286158?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODEyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMzYwODVlMS1hNjQ1LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xj8AUkTY33Ngvr8KD2Rg5eYeKkE0hfqE4E15uizIIJk=&emci=df95fc5b-ad44-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=236085e1-a645-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=21617867)**

Social Security is a promise from generation to generation.

| | Dear Peter,

On June 24, 2022, the nation cheered when the Supreme Court overturned Roe vs. Wade, a decision estimated to save over 150,000 pre-born babies a year. At the same time, **Democrats in Congress planned ways to continue to thwart pro-life efforts at the national level.** Now, more than ever, it is vital to have strong, dedicated pro-life members of Congress.

As your Republican nominee for Congressional District 1, I pledge to you that I will continue to fight for the unborn as your Congressman, just as I have as Smith County Judge. When Planned Parenthood and others challenged the Texas Heartbeat Law in Smith County, I led the efforts to defend it, and we won!

I firmly believe life begins at conception. That’s why I have earned endorsements from National Right to Life, Texas Right to Life PAC, and Texas Alliance for Life Federal PAC. Will you please join them and support my campaign for Congress? We cannot do it without you, and there are many more lives to save.
---
|
---
| Nathaniel Moran
Republican for U.S. Congress, TX-1

Climate change poses an existential threat to our planet. |
#

Peter, It’s never been more urgent: **We must secure a Green New Deal.** Putin’s war of aggression in Ukraine has caused global energy prices to soar, and in turn, New Yorkers and people across the country are seeing their utility bills rise. At the same time, the dangers posed by climate change have never been more apparent. As the planet warms, storms like Hurricane Ian are becoming stronger. The 10th District knows this all too well — areas of the city were devastated by Hurricane Sandy, and if we don’t act now, it’s only a matter of time before it happens again. Here is a fact Republicans need to understand: massive and sustained investment in domestic renewable energy production is the only way to achieve the lasting energy independence they talk so much about. That’s why Dan supports a Green New Deal — because we need an all-hands-on-deck approach to fight climate change. A Green New Deal will shore up our energy independence, create good-paying jobs, and position America to own the energy economy of the future. The first step is making sure Republicans understand that reality and bringing them to the table. Before it’s too late. **Right now, we need your help. | | When considering a Candidate for US Congress, Hawai'i District 1, please consider a positive change. Consider 41-year Service Veteran, US Navy SEAL (Cmdr ret), Conrad Kress.
[https://conradkressforhawaii.com/](https://conradkressforhawaii.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4d33350d5719789e58cb2bdf1&id=805c677d64&e=8947ac3645)
---
|
---
|
## Family Matters
If you are of the mind that your wife, your daughter, your granddaughter should not be subjected to sharing a bathroom, locker room, or shower room that falls under public accommodations and facilities with a individual who decides ‘He” is a “Woman” you need to consider the following: **Ed Case voted for\Cosponsored H.R.5-117th Congress (2021-2022)** This bill prohibits discrimination based on sex, sexual orientation, and gender identity in areas including public accommodations and facilities, education, federal funding, employment, housing, credit, and the jury system. Specifically, the bill defines and includes sex, sexual orientation, and gender identity among the prohibited categories of discrimination or segregation. The bill expands the definition of public accommodations to include places or establishments that provide (1) exhibitions, recreation, exercise, amusement, gatherings, or displays; (2) goods, services, or programs; and (3) transportation services. The bill allows the Department of Justice to intervene in equal protection actions in federal court on account of sexual orientation or gender identity. The bill prohibits an individual from being denied access to a shared facility, including a restroom, a locker room, and a dressing room, that is in accordance with the individual’s gender identity. Link the Actual Bill:
[https://www.congress.gov/bill/117th-congress/house-bill/5](https://conradkressforhawaii.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4d33350d5719789e58cb2bdf1&id=40f8fd0692&e=8947ac3645)
---
|
### Sports Matters in Hawai’i
**Ed Case voted AGAINST H.R.426-117th Congress (2021-2022)** This bill makes it a violation of federal law for a recipient of federal funds who operates, sponsors, or facilitates athletic programs or activities to permit a person whose sex is male to participate in an athletic program or activity that is designated for women or girls. The bill specifies that sex shall be recognized based solely on a person’s reproductive biology and genetics at birth. _**So it’s clear: Ed Case OPPOSES protecting Girls and Women in competitive Sports situations.**_
When questioned about this by a concerned citizen, here was Ed’s Response:
---
|
---
| He specifically states he is supporting Biden’s agenda (Executive Order 13988) as a priority as opposed to the concerned people of Hawai’i. Link to Response Letter:
[https://thecaseagainstcase.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/09/Ed-Case-Response-to-HR426-Concerns.pdf ](https://conradkressforhawaii.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4d33350d5719789e58cb2bdf1&id=7ad45eceac&e=8947ac3645) Link to the Bill:
[https://www.congress.gov/bill/117th-congress/house-bill/426](https://conradkressforhawaii.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4d33350d5719789e58cb2bdf1&id=f389522bf7&e=8947ac3645) **Title 9 Considerations**
[https://www.justice.gov/crt/title-ix ](https://conradkressforhawaii.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4d33350d5719789e58cb2bdf1&id=c4aca8ffa3&e=8947ac3645)
“ _No person in the United States shall, on the basis of sex, be excluded from participation in, be denied benefits of, or be subjected to discrimination under any educational program or activity receiving federal financial assistance.”_ **Beyond Public Safety, have you considered what this will do to Sports activities here is Hawai’i?** Do you believe it’s a good idea to allow what can rationally be considered a Male to compete and dominate your daughters in what was a Women’s Sport Division? Ed Case has consistently voted to erase the clear, rational lines between Male and Female.

clean_body: Health Care and the U.S. Senate Election in the News. | | | My name is Mark, and I'm with In Union. We are here to provide you with the latest research on issues that affect working people’s lives, examine the records of elected officials on those issues, and give you ways to hold your elected representatives accountable. Let’s dive in. | HELPING PENNSYLVANIANS GET QUALITY, AFFORDABLE HEALTH CARE Governor Tom Wolf and Lt. Governor John Fetterman , Pennsylvania’s state-based health care marketplace. Pennie has been praised by consumers across the state because it: Provides affordable health care coverage to Pennsylvanians Offers first-rate customer service Saves you money over time through a reinsurance program Want to learn more about Pennie, the state’s go-to source for health insurance? Visit or call 844-844-8040. Health Care and the U.S. Senate Election in the News Too many hardworking Pennsylvania families are feeling left behind, unable to make ends meet. Health care costs are on the rise, including the price of prescription drugs. At In Union, we believe that all work has dignity, but countless working families are forced to choose between buying food and going to the doctor. Or putting gas in the car and paying the mortgage or rent. These are serious issues that require serious responses from our elected leaders. In this edition, we focus on the two U.S. Senate candidates to help you make an informed choice as we enter election season. JOHN FETTERMAN, LT. GOVERNOR Health Care as a Fundamental Right John Fetterman believes health care—including access to reproductive health care—is a fundamental right, as basic as housing, food, and education. As Lt. Governor, John Fetterman worked with Governor Wolf to protect high-quality health care for 2.2 million Pennsylvanians. ; ] Expanding Medicare to Cover More Families As a Senator, Fetterman plans to work to expand access to health care by lowering the Medicare enrollment age. He also believes we must mandate that Medicare include vision, dental, and hearing care. ] Protecting Pennsylvania’s Seniors Increasing costs in Pennsylvania are disproportionately hurting our seniors, especially the high costs of prescription drugs. In the U.S. Senate, John Fetterman will protect and improve Social Security and Medicare. He also supports a plan to cap the price of insulin at $35 per month. ] | DR. MEHMET OZ, TV PERSONALITY Investor in Big Pharma Dr. Mehmet Oz is a major investor in Big Pharma, even though he publicly blames them for skyrocketing insulin costs. To date, he’s invested more than $730,000 in big pharmaceutical companies —and they’ve returned the favor with nearly $20,000 in contributions to his campaign. Days after securing the Republican nomination for Senate, Dr. Oz gave a speech to a lobbying group that pushes a pyramid scheme marketing to consumers. ; ; ] Amassed Enormous Profits by Deceiving Consumers Dr. Oz is a retired heart surgeon who has made tens of millions of dollars deceiving consumers. In 2012, he told his viewers there was a “magic bean”— or green coffee extract—to help you lose weight. This was entirely discredited and resulted in lawsuits for the company that manufactured it. ; ] Supports Plan to Defund Social Security and Medicare Dr. Oz has praised a plan to put Social Security and Medicare on the chopping block every five years , opening the door to extreme plans to privatize these benefits and put the retirement security and health of millions of seniors at risk. Dr. Oz also supports letting insurance companies charge higher premiums and deny care to people with preexisting conditions. ; ; ] ---|--- We’re out in the community talking with Pennsylvanians. Here’s what we’re hearing about health care. | Steph is a single mother with two daughters. She’s concerned about her children and says it’s impossible to find affordable childcare. She wishes politicians would do more to focus on working families. Steph M., Irwin ---|--- Daniel is concerned about finding affordable health care and is shocked that Americans must spend thousands of dollars out of their own pockets to have a child or receive treatment for a disease. He wants lobbyists out of our health care system and wants health care overhauled so it actually serves working people, and so that no American has to take on a crippling financial burden if they get sick. Daniel G., Edgebrook, Pittsburgh | | Gary has worked in nursing and retirement homes and worries about proper care for senior citizens in Pennsylvania. He wants to see more done to protect our most vulnerable citizens and ensure they can live their lives with dignity. Gary B., Arlington, Pittsburgh HEALTH CARE RESOURCES FOR WORKING FAMILIES It can be difficult to navigate the complexities of receiving health care in Pennsylvania, especially for those suffering from an illness. Below are some resources that may help you and your family access care. Community HealthChoices – Care for Seniors Pennsylvania Community HealthChoices provides health care services and increases access to community programs for seniors and people with disabilities. Call 855-481-6777 Visit PACE and PACENET PACE and PACENET are programs offered by Pennsylvania to provide low-cost prescription drugs for those ages 65 and up. Call 800-225-7223 Visit That’s it for now. We’ll keep doing the research on the big issues in your community and help you get the best, accurate information. We’re also going to keep knocking on doors and talking with people directly so we can work together to hold our politicians accountable. Visit www.inunionusa.com to take action and make your voice heard. -Mark from In Union Follow us on social media! ** Paid for by In Union USA () and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee | | Sent via . Team,

You may know the NDRC as the force that has led the national effort to eradicate gerrymandering. But as President Obama said, **the fight for fair maps is just one part of the fight to protect our democracy** – and in the past couple of years, Republican attacks on democracy have escalated in both strength and number.

So as the NDRC works to expand our successful model to focus on fights that are critical to safeguarding our system of government, this much is obvious: **Election deniers and insurrectionists are not compatible with a healthy democracy.**

That’s why I’m sharing the maps above. They highlight the states where NDRC-endorsed Democracy Defenders are in **head-to-head races** with Republicans who deny that President Biden won in 2020 – and, in many cases, _won’t commit to accepting the results of future elections_.
[**_Will you help us support Democracy Defenders and carry out all of our work?_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52111456/371251809/-661765744?&amount=30&refcode=20221006.3r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg0MTI3YzcxLWIxNDUtZWQxMS1iNDk1LTAwMjI0ODI1OGQzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=EThXa1vyP9Hq4_16JjyGEuITMTNj3d8IC8HcJdRdSdo=)
The outcomes of these races won’t just determine who has control of Congress after 2022 – they’ll have implications for 2024 and beyond. Many of the candidates who win on the state level this year will play critical roles in administering and certifying results of future elections. So **it’s essential that we defeat MAGA Republicans and prevent them from gaining the power to overturn future results that they don’t like.**
That means we need to be able to:
1. Give our nearly 500 Democracy Defender candidates the support they need to win.
2. Stop Republicans from corrupting this year's pool of election workers.
3. Fight back against the GOP's relentless efforts to curtail voting rights.

I hope I can count on your support, team. I know not everyone is able to donate every time we ask, but **if you can contribute even $10, it would make a big difference.**

Obama said, the fight for fair maps is just one part of the fight to protect our democracy. | | = Team, You may know the NDRC as the force that has led the national effort to eradicate gerrymandering. But as President Obama said, the fight for fair maps is just one part of the fight to protect our democracy – and in the past couple of years, Republican attacks on democracy have escalated in both strength and number. So as the NDRC works to expand our successful model to focus on fights that are critical to safeguarding our system of government, this much is obvious: Election deniers and insurrectionists are not compatible with a healthy democracy. That’s why I’m sharing the maps above. They highlight the states where NDRC-endorsed Democracy Defenders are in head-to-head races with Republicans who deny that President Biden won in 2020 – and, in many cases, won’t commit to accepting the results of future elections. = The outcomes of these races won’t just determine who has control of Congress after 2022 – they’ll have implications for 2024 and beyond. Many of the candidates who win on the state level this year will play critical roles in administering and certifying results of future elections. So it’s essential that we defeat MAGA Republicans and prevent them from gaining the power to overturn future results that they don’t like. That means we need to be able to: 1. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, this will
be a longer email, but it’s important so we hope you take a few minutes to
read it all.

The DCCC and establishment leaders have gotten themselves into a sticky
situation in TX-28:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/117012?refcode=em20221006-25439&t=1002&akid=25439%2E1203867%2ETm9Di2 ][IMG]

The Democratic establishment went to bat for Henry Cuellar while he was
facing an extremely competitive primary election from Justice Democrat
Jessica Cisneros.

Henry Cuellar is the last anti-choice Democrat in the House. The election
was so close that it went to a runoff and a re-count and Jessica fell
short by less than 300 votes.

We’re facing an unprecedented moment after the Supreme Court overturned
Roe, and Democrats have a fighting chance to hold onto our majority. But,
the majority in the House could hinge on TX-28 where major pro-choice
organizations aren’t opening their wallets to help him win — because he is
against reproductive freedom.

Nancy Pelosi, Steny Hoyer, Hakeem Jeffries, and Jim Clyburn decided to
back an entrenched, corporate backed incumbent and now Republicans are
spending massive amounts of money to try and flip the district.

This all could have been avoided if Democratic leadership didn’t help
Henry Cuellar win the primary by fewer than 300 votes.

The Democratic Party needs an overhaul and we need leaders who will
actually fight to elect people who believe in reproductive freedom. That’s
why our work to transform the Democratic Party from the inside out is so
important.

Money has always been one of the biggest things holding us back from doing
more. It’s the one thing that our establishment opponents have a seemingly
endless supply of and that we’re always working hard to raise just a
fraction of what they can raise.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/117012?refcode=em20221006-25439&t=1003&akid=25439%2E1203867%2ETm9Di2 ]Peter, we
need you with us. Please contribute $3 today to help elect
the next generation of the Squad to Congress in November and support our
work of challenging the status-quo for the long-term.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/117012?refcode=em20221006-25439&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=25439%2E1203867%2ETm9Di2 ]Contribute

We are in a fight for the soul of the Democratic Party and we’re so
thankful to have you with us.

Thank you,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1023&akid=25439%2E1203867%2ETm9Di2 ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1024&akid=25439%2E1203867%2ETm9Di2 ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20221006-25439-footer&t=1025&refcode2=25439_1203867_Tm9Di2&akid=25439%2E1203867%2ETm9Di2

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://go.justicedemocrats.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1026&akid=25439%2E1203867%2ETm9Di2
