Next month, I will vote for Libertarian Brian Peotter for US Senate, and I encourage all Colorado Conservatives to do the same.

The reasons are clear: Brian Peotter is the only conservative on the ballot for US Senate. The COGOP’s candidate in the race has no grounding in conservative positions, nor any proven interest in supporting them.

Foremost among conservative principles is protecting the unborn. Libertarian Brian Peotter is Pro-Life. The COGOP’s candidate, Joe O’Dea, pretends to be, but he supports murderous abortion before 20 weeks of gestation. To O’Dea, apparently, some murders in the womb are acceptable, depending on the calendar.

Libertarian Brian Peotter is a fiscal conservative. He believes the Biden Inflation Reduction Act and the Infrastructure Bill are inflationary. The COGOP’s candidate O’Dea has no such clarity: He has declared one inflationary, but not the other. Such cloudy logic becomes clearer when we learn he and his core supporters have become wealthy from government contracts.

On abortion and other issues, Libertarian Brian Peotter is vastly more conservative than this “pay-to-play” fake Republican who bought his way on to the ballot, skipping the traditional caucus and assembly process, avoiding Republican voters by paying for petition signatures.

Avoiding the state assembly was not merely political cowardice. It was a deliberate strategy to hide his true political views from Republican voters. When O’Dea’s liberal positions were revealed, many in the so-called conservative media were surprised, and some have since declared him unsupportable.

The squishy state party, their wealthy donors, and RINO media pundits sold out rank-and-file Grassroots Conservatives by advocating for this fake Republican and for open primaries – which allow non-Republicans to choose our Republican nominee. Those same RINOs also deliberately ignored Election Integrity – as though a serious problem most Americans believe is a top priority will somehow fix itself. It won’t.

This upcoming election will be a powerful referendum on the RINO’s actions and inactions. Even with unchecked manipulation of the voting process, such as inaccurate voter rolls (see Judicial Watch’s lawsuits), mail-in ballot harvesting (see 2,000 Mules), and hackable electronic voting systems (see Kamala Harris talking about it in 2018), we will see waning support for the COGOP’s weak Republican candidates.

Recent credible polling puts the anemic campaign of “Pay to Play O’Dea” 10 to 14 points down. Only his campaign has declared the race close – a cynical effort to attract donations and reduce the personal costs of losing big.

O’Dea is definitely not a conservative, nor a Republican for any reason other than convenience. It is well documented he contributed to over a dozen hard-left, socialist Democrats – including the one he is feebly losing to in this 2022 race. Conservatives see through his failed political venture as a safety valve for leftists, on the remote chance the elections might spin out of control.

During the campaign, O’Dea laughably declared he would govern like Joe Manchin, the Democrat Senator from West Virginia. Joe Manchin gave in to the corrupt demands of Chuck Schumer after negotiating a better price for his vote. Far from a hero, Manchin has proven himself to be a mere political prostitute, interested only in the best price for his services. In his self-assessment of his presumed legislative style, I believe O’Dea to be accurate.

If the COGOP’s candidate O’Dea were elected, he would be to the left of every other fake Republican in office, including the contemptible Mitt Romney. Another Mitt Romney or Liz Cheney will not move the red wave forward, nor make America great again. Another spoiled apple in the US Senate is not a solution to the problems we face – it is a recipe for more pain and disaster.

But we know the COGOP’s candidate O’Dea has near-zero chance of being elected. Thus, Colorado Conservatives should stand up and defend their belief in conservative principles by voting for conservative principles. This cycle, those principles are best upheld by Libertarian Brian Peotter. Such a vote is not an abandonment of our true, honest, beloved Republican Party – it is a statement that we clearly see Colorado’s Republican Party has abandoned us. Colorado’s Grassroots Conservatives want our party back. We can leave this sclerotic COGOP a resounding message that unelectable establishment candidates are not worth our time, money, or consideration.

The Republican Party – the Party of Lincoln – used to advocate for government Of The People, By The People, For The People. It has been led down a cynical path of indifference to principles – and of NO difference from the opposition party. After predictably dismal results this November, it will be time for conservatives to restore the Republican Party to its founding principles. We need those principles now more than ever.
If there were a real Republican on the Colorado ballot for US Senate, I would support him or her. There isn’t. There is only a fake Republican, a pay-to-play opportunist with no conservative values or agenda. He merits no support, and he’s not likely to get much. Let the COGOP know we will have a party with conservative principles, not squishy candidates with a power fetish.

Our Republic is at stake, and it must always come first, not our political party.

For US Senate in 2022, Libertarian Brian Peotter is and ought to be the choice of all Colorado Conservatives.

For God and Country,
---

| Ron Hanks, Colorado State Representative, House District 60

body:
[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/46?t=1001&akid=5959%2E3611125%2E_o2Z9_ ][IMG]

Hello,

With just 34 days to go, the race for Ohio’s Senate seat couldn’t be
closer. So I think it’s time we talk about a field margin.

Research shows that a ground game focused on persuading the right people
and turning out the right voters can determine a competitive election. And
well... this race couldn’t be tighter.

We’ve spent months reviewing our projections and planning our strategy,
but there is only one way we’ll win this race and flip Ohio blue: we have
to knock on more doors than the other side.

Political experts have ranked Ohio as one of the most likely seats to flip
and poll after poll shows us within the margin of error. That means
whoever turns out the most voters will most likely win this seat and
decide Senate control.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/24730?t=1007&akid=5959%2E3611125%2E_o2Z9_ ]The most important thing you can do to help us overcome the GOP and
flip Ohio blue is by signing up to volunteer right now. We’re tracking 27%
behind our turnout goal for ZipCode/your area and I need you to personally
step up today. I can’t stress this enough.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/24730?t=1008&akid=5959%2E3611125%2E_o2Z9_ ]SIGN ME UP

Whether it’s lacing up your shoes to hit the doors or calling folks from
your couch, we need hundreds of volunteers to meet our projections and
fulfill our path to victory.

Ohio’s open Senate seat could be decided by less than a percentage point.
And whether or not you step up today could determine where the dice falls.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/24730?t=1009&akid=5959%2E3611125%2E_o2Z9_ ]Please, sign up now to join our growing list of grassroots volunteers.
I wouldn’t ask if it didn’t make a difference.

Thanks for everything you do—I really mean that.

Tim

## Tom Patti Campaign Sends
Cease and Desist Letter to Josh Harder
---
|
---
| STOCKTON, CA – Campaign counsel for the Tom Patti for Congress campaign today sent a letter to Josh Harder demanding that Harder’s campaign “immediately cease and desist from all messages or statements of any kind asserting that Supervisor Tom Patti is under investigation for bribery or any other wrongdoing, or that Supervisor Patti voted to raise gas taxes.” (See letter attached). The letter was sent because, despite knowing that such statements are provably false, the Harder campaign has failed to take down billboards containing the false accusations.

As the letter points out, on Tuesday, October 4, 2022, the San Joaquin County Board of Supervisors voted NOT to censure Supervisor Patti or take any other action as a result of various unfounded accusations. Nonetheless, Harder’s billboard near the Tracy Boulevard exit is still up, incorrectly stating: “Supervisor Tom Patti Under Investigation for Bribery.”

The Harder campaign also has multiple billboards stating that “Supervisor Tom Patti Voted to Raise the Gas Tax by 40%.” The Sacramento Bee fact checked the statement on September 22, 2022, and exposed the allegation as false (labeling it as “out of context”). As pointed out in the article, in fact the gas tax was passed by the California legislature, controlled by Harder’s Democrat party.

“Harder’s illegal and defamatory smear campaign is obviously designed to take attention away from soaring gas prices and inflation caused by him and his party,” Patti said. “He falsely tries to pin a gas tax on me, while it is his party’s anti-energy policies that are the main cause of gas prices doubling over the past two years,” said Patti. “We must stop attacking American energy production and pursue instead an ‘all of the above’ approach and restore our energy independence,” Patti said. “That is what will bring down gas prices, not the radical ‘green new deal’ that Harder and his party are focused on.”

You knew your job front and back. You trusted your leaders. You could count on your team.

| Friends,

As a young boy growing up in Clearwater, I remember fondly all of the fall festivals that my family would attend.

Fifteen years ago, my business partners agreed with me that one of the ways we could give back to the community was to host a family friendly “Fall Festival."

We also understand that raising a family today is more expensive than ever. That’s why every fall for the past fifteen years, we’ve thrown a FREE event with food, drinks, face painting, live music and of course a free Pumpkin. 🎃

On behalf of myself and my partners at Carlson, Meissner, Hart & Hayslett, we hope to see you Saturday, October 15 for some fun and fellowship.

Sincerely,

Friend,
---
The year was 1981. Inflation was 11.89% in Great Britain. Unemployment was 9.6%. Everyone — even members of her own party — expected British Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher to cave and abandon her conservative economic agenda. They expected her to do a “U-turn.”
Instead, she offered one of the most famous lines of her tenure:**“You turn if you want to. The lady’s not for turning.”**
---
[](https://links.standforamericanow.com/u/click?_t=d85fab909a98477596691a746a1de4c5&_m=d2fcda5b7a5e4fc6abbb384039e94c19&_e=AsWCFLs_a2tnB-tiXGHXS389H-4OjGOMebHFOQ6_Yjib6fvifx8KvZFjl6kmIi4n7CCsxbpsUvX_V-nDOvj5zGYO9BYpbJQCgX0B_fc1kv2sYVOC84q5E0Q72VjyOt8sxnQwPtc0C7OiOAockVk6JU3lE0tz5mQ7QSPR34PH2YMfSZBWrwMbZzUwUqE33bVRQamRbISASc1HB3-cgt_dgDJqUpgzPIegxSH6yLMYVS-qW252A6vUYmvT_KnP2NIGUdhSpNT_mRceLt-g1ekjtw%3D%3D)

It is grisly. It is gruesome. And it is more proof this man should be nowhere near the U.S. Senate. | | | | | | On the other side, in John Fetterman, we have a man who chose to take an elite education and live in Braddock, PA, to serve the people struggling there. He has fought for everything you'd want, from abortion rights to universal healthcare to gun safety. As importantly, he's promised to rid us of the filibuster and support any legislation strengthening voting rights and democracy. A man of the people, or one who killed man's best friend? Again and again. And again. Thank you for fighting to increase the quality of the Senate! body:
Social media is a powerful tool for education.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20221006-3475-header&t=1&akid=3475%2E2526796%2E5FJ2m7)
Do you know why Alexandria runs her Instagram and Twitter herself?
While other politicians might hand those jobs off to staff, Alexandria dedicates the time to running some of her own social media accounts because she knows that social media is a critical tool for building and educating our mass movement. **And she specifically uses social media to share important insights into the political process that few other elected officials are willing to divulge.**
Remember the time she reposted digital security tutorials so folks seeking abortions in red states could stay safe in a post-Roe world? Or when she was slated to question Mark Zuckerberg, and directly asked her followers on Twitter what kinds of questions they’d like to see him answer?
[Alexandria chooses to spend her time educating her followers and pulling people into the political process, instead of making calls to donors like other politicians do daily. This is only possible because incredible supporters like you make small-dollar donations to our campaign. But recently, fundraising has sagged. Can you help turn that trend around and chip in $3?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221006.PD03O_&refcode=em20221006-3475-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3475%2E2526796%2E5FJ2m7)

Whether it’s giving you a tour of the Capitol Dome, or going live from her kitchen, Alexandria is constantly touching base with the community. She shows up to answer your questions, but also to hear from you – to give your feedback a direct platform!
[Alexandria runs her own social media accounts, but she can’t do everything alone. Team AOC needs your donations today to keep the fight for an equitable future strong and consistent. Can you chip in $3 so we don’t fall short of our fundraising goals?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221006.PD03O_&refcode=em20221006-3475-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=3475%2E2526796%2E5FJ2m7)
In solidarity,
Team AOC
P.S. If you haven’t already, we highly recommend checking out AOC’s [Instagram](http://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14943?t=6&akid=3475%2E2526796%2E5FJ2m7) and [Twitter](http://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14944?t=7&akid=3475%2E2526796%2E5FJ2m7), where she’s known to speak truth about unjust systems in this country and across the world — and of course, share many photos of her intrepid bulldog sidekick. 🐶

body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

The journey to this moment has been a long one,
Derek.

But before I tell you more, I need your help in the final stretch of this
race.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=Sa_em_221006_B5_SYAInstagram_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=11111%2E1862389%2ExdE3zT ]Early voting starts in less than two weeks and my team can’t fall short
between now and October 17. Will you chip in $5 right now
to help fuel our Early Vote campaign? Every vote counts in this election —
and so does every contribution.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=Sa_em_221006_B5_SYAInstagram_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=11111%2E1862389%2ExdE3zT ]DONATE

Derek, I began
this journey in June 2017, when I stood in Chehaw Park in Albany to
announce my candidacy for governor. I ran for 16 months. By the end of the
campaign, our team had mobilized the most diverse coalition Georgia had
ever seen before.

Even as the odds mounted against us, and Republicans worked hard to
decrease access to voting, we fought to the very end. With hope. With
determination.

But I didn’t get the job in 2018.

But I didn’t quit, I kept working from Georgians. I changed my how but
never lost what drives me. And I decided to try again because I know
Georgia can be extraordinary if we truly invest in our people. I believe
in meeting people where they are, not where you want them to be. I believe
that if we want people to turn out, we have to show that it is worth the
pain of hope.

But it’s not about 2018, 2020 or 2021 anymore. This year, we face a
once-in-a-generation opportunity to make unprecedented progress both today
and tomorrow for our families. We look to the future and imagine the
incredible story that we can write for ourselves and for our families — if
we have a governor who sees all of us.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=Sa_em_221006_B5_SYAInstagram_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=11111%2E1862389%2ExdE3zT ]That’s why I know it’s worth it to fight. To try again. To do
everything we can to win. So, that’s why I ask,
Derek. Will you do everything
in your power to help us get voters to the polls in two weeks and win?
